2. Windows Updateファイル (`C:\Windows\SoftwareDistribution\Download`): 1.31 GB

### 追加の推奨事項
1. Windows Updateのクリーンアップ（管理者権限が必要）:
   ```powershell
   dism.exe /online /cleanup-image /startcomponentcleanup /resetbase
   ```
   管理者権限で実行すると、さらに数GB確保できる可能性があります。

2. ストレージセンサー:
   - 設定 → システム → ストレージ → ストレージセンサーを実行

3. 大きなファイルの確認:
   - 不要な動画やインストーラーを削除
   - ダウンロードフォルダの整理

現在の空き容量は17.31GBです。システムの動作に必要な最低限の容量は確保できています。

+# Codex (zapabob fork) — Portfolio-ready AI engineering repo
+
+## TL;DR（採用担当者向け要約） / Recruiter TL;DR
+
+**日本語**:  
+本リポジトリは、AI開発を **安全に（承認ゲート）**・**速く（並列サブエージェント）**・**再現可能に（ベンチ/手順）** 回すための統合実装です。  
+“主張”ではなく、**再現手順と定量指標**へのリンクを入口にしています。
+
+**English**:  
+This repo integrates an AI engineering workflow with **approval-gated execution**, **parallel sub-agents**, **reproducible benchmarks**, and a **GUI/visualization** surface.  
+The README is intentionally evidence-first (docs + benchmarks you can reproduce).
+
+---
+
+## First 5 minutes（最短で価値→証拠へ）
+
+- **Start here（見る順番）**: &#96;portfolio/README.md&#96;
+- **Plan Mode Quickstart (5 min)**: &#96;docs/plan/README.md&#96;
+- **Benchmarks (Sub-agents / CUDA)**: &#96;docs/benchmarks/README.md&#96;
+- **Examples (talkable demos)**: &#96;examples/README.md&#96;
+- **Architecture**: &#96;ARCHITECTURE.md&#96;
+
+---
+
+## Why this is portfolio-grade（“刺さる”ポイント）
+
+### 1) Safety model / 安全モデル
+- **JP**: 計画段階は副作用なし、**承認後にのみ**実行。運用前提のガードレール設計。  
+- **EN**: Planning is side-effect-free; execution happens **only after approval**, designed for auditability.
+
+### 2) Measurable performance / 定量評価
+- **JP**: Sub-agents / CUDAの**測定方法と目標値**をドキュメント化。  
+- **EN**: Bench methodology + target metrics are documented (not “trust me” claims).
+- Evidence: &#96;docs/benchmarks/subagents.md&#96;, &#96;docs/benchmarks/cuda.md&#96;
+
+### 3) End-to-end breadth / 実装の射程
+- **JP**: Rustコア + Node/TS + GUI + CI/CDまで一つのリポジトリで追える。  
+- **EN**: You can trace an end-to-end system: core runtime, CLI, GUI, extensions, and CI.
+
+---
+
+## Repository map（面接で深掘りされる場所）
+
+- **Rust core**: &#96;codex-rs/&#96; (core runtime, CLI/TUI, orchestration)
+- **Node CLI**: &#96;codex-cli/&#96;
+- **GUI**: &#96;gui/&#96; (frontend surface)
+- **IDE extensions**: &#96;extensions/&#96;
+- **Docs (guides/bench/ops)**: &#96;docs/&#96;
+- **CI/CD**: &#96;.github/workflows/&#96;
+
+More structure details: &#96;.github/REPOSITORY_STRUCTURE.md&#96;
+

+# Codex (zapabob fork) — Portfolio-ready AI engineering repo
+
+## TL;DR（採用担当者向け要約） / Recruiter TL;DR
+
+**日本語**:  
+本リポジトリは、AI開発を **安全に（承認ゲート）**・**速く（並列サブエージェント）**・**再現可能に（ベンチ/手順）** 回すための統合実装です。  
+“主張”ではなく、**再現手順と定量指標**へのリンクを入口にしています。
+
+**English**:  
+This repo integrates an AI engineering workflow with **approval-gated execution**, **parallel sub-agents**, **reproducible benchmarks**, and a **GUI/visualization** surface.  
+The README is intentionally evidence-first (docs + benchmarks you can reproduce).
+
+---
+
+## First 5 minutes（最短で価値→証拠へ）
+
+- **Start here（見る順番）**: &#96;portfolio/README.md&#96;
+- **Plan Mode Quickstart (5 min)**: &#96;docs/plan/README.md&#96;
+- **Benchmarks (Sub-agents / CUDA)**: &#96;docs/benchmarks/README.md&#96;
+- **Examples (talkable demos)**: &#96;examples/README.md&#96;
+- **Architecture**: &#96;ARCHITECTURE.md&#96;
+
+---
+
+## Why this is portfolio-grade（“刺さる”ポイント）
+
+### 1) Safety model / 安全モデル
+- **JP**: 計画段階は副作用なし、**承認後にのみ**実行。運用前提のガードレール設計。  
+- **EN**: Planning is side-effect-free; execution happens **only after approval**, designed for auditability.
+
+### 2) Measurable performance / 定量評価
+- **JP**: Sub-agents / CUDAの**測定方法と目標値**をドキュメント化。  
+- **EN**: Bench methodology + target metrics are documented (not “trust me” claims).
+- Evidence: &#96;docs/benchmarks/subagents.md&#96;, &#96;docs/benchmarks/cuda.md&#96;
+
+### 3) End-to-end breadth / 実装の射程
+- **JP**: Rustコア + Node/TS + GUI + CI/CDまで一つのリポジトリで追える。  
+- **EN**: You can trace an end-to-end system: core runtime, CLI, GUI, extensions, and CI.
+
+---
+
+## Repository map（面接で深掘りされる場所）
+
+- **Rust core**: &#96;codex-rs/&#96; (core runtime, CLI/TUI, orchestration)
+- **Node CLI**: &#96;codex-cli/&#96;
+- **GUI**: &#96;gui/&#96; (frontend surface)
+- **IDE extensions**: &#96;extensions/&#96;
+- **Docs (guides/bench/ops)**: &#96;docs/&#96;
+- **CI/CD**: &#96;.github/workflows/&#96;
+
+More structure details: &#96;.github/REPOSITORY_STRUCTURE.md&#96;
+
+---
+
+## Portfolio index（採用担当者向け導線）
+
+&#96;portfolio/README.md&#96; に **「全体像 → 証拠 → 深掘り」** の順番を整理しています。

## 対応完了（差分を拾って日英併記に再構成したで）

### やったこと
- **`README.md` を日英併記に再構成**して、AIテック企業の採用担当が見たい順（価値→証拠→深掘り）に整理した
- 既存の差分（もともと空だった`README.md`に追加した内容）をベースに、**Evidence-first**（再現手順/ベンチ/例へのリンク先頭）へ再編
- 入口導線はそのまま `portfolio/README.md` に接続（「まずここ」）

### 新しいREADMEの構成（刺さる順）
- **TL;DR（日英）**: 何が強いかを30秒で理解
- **First 5 minutes**: `docs/plan/README.md` / `docs/benchmarks/*` / `examples/README.md` への最短リンク
- **Why portfolio-grade**: Safety / Measurable perf / End-to-end breadth を日英で提示
- **Repository map**: 面接で深掘りされやすいディレクトリ案内
- **Portfolio index**: `portfolio/`への導線

必要なら次は、README内に **数値（例: Sub-agents平均2.59x、CUDA平均3.74x）** を“引用付き”で埋め込んで、さらに刺さるように強化するで。

---

_**User**_

数値はじっそくしていないから確実な指標やDeepresearch、planモード、サブエージェント、QCエージェント。A2Aによるエージェント間の通信によるコンフリクト予防、gitworkreeによる並列開発　QCコンペティションなどの独自性を押し出してSakanaAI、AMD等のAIテック企業採用担当者の目を引くようなREADMEにしたい

---

_**Agent (model default, mode Agent)**_



---

実測数値は避け、独自機能（Deep Research、Plan Mode、サブエージェント、QCエージェント、A2A通信/コンフリクト予防、Git worktree並列開発、QCコンペティション）を前面に。コードベースを確認して、存在する機能だけを強調する構成にする。

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\plan\\execution-modes.md",

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Execution Modes - Detailed Guide",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "**Version**: 0.57.0",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "## Overview",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "plan mode supports 3 execution strategies, each optimized for different use cases.",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "| Mode | Use Case | Speed | Quality | Complexity |",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "|------|----------|-------|---------|------------|",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "| **Single** | Simple edits | ⚡⚡⚡ | ⭐⭐ | Low |",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "| **Orchestrated** | Complex features | ⚡⚡ | ⭐⭐⭐ | Medium |",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "| **Competition** | Optimization | ⚡ | ⭐⭐⭐⭐ | High |",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "## Single Mode",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "### When to Use",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ Single-file changes",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ Typo fixes, docstring additions",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ Simple refactoring (rename variable)",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ Quick iterations",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "### Architecture",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "Plan (approved)",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "    ↓",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "Single LLM Agent",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "    ↓",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "File edits + tests",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "    ↓",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "Done",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "### Example",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "**Task**: Add docstring to a function",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan \"Add docstring to calculate_total()\" --mode=single",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "**Execution**:",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "1. Single agent reads function",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "2. Generates docstring",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "3. Applies patch",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "4. Runs linter",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "5. Done in ~30 seconds",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "## Orchestrated Mode (Default)",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "### When to Use",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ Multi-file features",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ Full-stack changes (backend + frontend)",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ Database migrations",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ Security-sensitive code",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ Test generation required",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "### Architecture",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "Plan (approved)",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "    ↓",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "Central Planner",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "text": "    ├── Task DAG",
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "    └── Sub-Agent Assignments",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "        ↓",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "Parallel Execution",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "text": "├─ Backend Agent    → API changes",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "├─ Frontend Agent   → UI updates",
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "├─ Database Agent   → Schema migrations",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "text": "├─ Security Agent   → Vulnerability review",
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "└─ QA Agent         → Test generation",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "text": "    ↓",
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "Integrator",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "├─ Collect patches",
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "├─ Run linters/tests",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "text": "└─ Prepare PR",
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "    ↓",
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "text": "Done",
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "### Example",
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "text": "**Task**: Migrate session auth to JWT",
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan \"Refactor auth to JWT\" --mode=orchestrated",
            "lineNumber": 96
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 97
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 98
          },
          {
            "text": "**Execution Flow**:",
            "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 100
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Planner** analyzes Plan",
            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Identifies 5 work items (JWT service, DB migration, API endpoints, frontend client, tests)",
            "lineNumber": 102
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.4836982488632202
    },

          {

          },
          {
            "text": "async fn execute_plan(plan_id: &amp;str, plan_dir: &amp;PathBuf) -&gt; Result&lt;()&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 628
          },
          {
            "text": "    let plan_file = plan_dir.join(format!(\"{}.json\", plan_id));",
            "lineNumber": 629
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 630
          },
          {
            "text": "    if !plan_file.exists() {",

          },
          {
            "text": "        anyhow::bail!(\"Plan not found: {}\", plan_id);",

          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 633
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 634
          },
          {
            "text": "    let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&amp;plan_file)?;",
            "lineNumber": 635
          },
          {
            "text": "    let plan: codex_core::plan::PlanBlock = serde_json::from_str(&amp;content)?;",
            "lineNumber": 636
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 637
          },
          {
            "text": "    println!(\"🚀 Executing Plan: {}\", plan.title);",
            "lineNumber": 638
          },
          {
            "text": "    println!(\"📋 ID: {}\", plan.id);",
            "lineNumber": 639
          },
          {
            "text": "    println!(\"⏱️  Starting execution...\");",
            "lineNumber": 640
          },
          {
            "text": "    println!();",
            "lineNumber": 641
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 642
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Note: This is a simplified execution for CLI",
            "lineNumber": 643
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Full execution requires PlanOrchestrator which needs AgentRuntime",
            "lineNumber": 644
          },
          {
            "text": "    // For now, we just update the state and show a message",
            "lineNumber": 645
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 646
          },
          {
            "text": "    if !plan.state.can_execute() {",
            "lineNumber": 647
          },
          {
            "text": "        anyhow::bail!(",
            "lineNumber": 648
          },
          {
            "text": "            \"Plan is not approved. Current state: {}. Please approve it first with: codex Plan approve {}\",",
            "lineNumber": 649
          },
          {
            "text": "            plan.state,",
            "lineNumber": 650
          },
          {
            "text": "            plan_id",
            "lineNumber": 651
          },
          {
            "text": "        );",
            "lineNumber": 652
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 653
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 654
          },
          {
            "text": "    println!(\"✅ Plan execution would be triggered here\");",
            "lineNumber": 655
          },
          {
            "text": "    println!(\"📝 Note: Full orchestrated execution requires agent runtime setup\");",
            "lineNumber": 656
          },
          {
            "text": "    println!();",
            "lineNumber": 657
          },
          {
            "text": "    println!(\"Simulated execution steps:\");",
            "lineNumber": 658
          },
          {
            "text": "    for (i, work_item) in plan.work_items.iter().enumerate() {",
            "lineNumber": 659
          },
          {
            "text": "        println!(",
            "lineNumber": 660
          },
          {
            "text": "            \"  {}. {} (files: {})\",",
            "lineNumber": 661
          },
          {
            "text": "            i + 1,",
            "lineNumber": 662
          },
          {
            "text": "            work_item.name,",
            "lineNumber": 663
          },
          {
            "text": "            work_item.files_touched.join(\", \")",
            "lineNumber": 664
          },
          {
            "text": "        );",
            "lineNumber": 665
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 666
          },
          {
            "text": "    println!();",
            "lineNumber": 667
          },
          {
            "text": "    println!(\"🎉 Execution simulation complete\");",
            "lineNumber": 668
          },
          {
            "text": "    println!();",
            "lineNumber": 669
          },
          {
            "text": "    println!(\"Next steps:\");",
            "lineNumber": 670
          },
          {
            "text": "    println!(",
            "lineNumber": 671
          },
          {
            "text": "        \"  1. Check execution logs: codex Plan executions --Plan-id {}\"",
            "lineNumber": 672
          }
        ]
      },

    },
    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\plan\\README.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 96
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Plan Mode Quickstart - 5分で再現可能",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "**Status**: Stable | **Proof**: このガイド通りに動く",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🎯 5分で試せるPlan Mode",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "Plan Modeは**タスクを計画→承認→実行**の3段階で安全にAI開発を進める機能です。",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "### Step 1: インストール確認 (30秒)",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "npm install -g @zapabob/codex",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "codex --version",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "# codex-cli 2.8.3",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "### Step 2: Plan Mode有効化 (30秒)",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan on",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "# Plan mode enabled",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "### Step 3: 簡単なタスク計画 (1分)",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan \"Add a simple logging function to utils.js\"",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "### Step 4: 計画内容を確認 (1分)",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan export bp-123 --format=md",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "# docs/Plans/bp-123.md が生成される",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "### Step 5: 承認して実行 (1分)",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /approve bp-123",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "codex execute bp-123",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "### Step 6: 結果確認 (1分)",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "# utils.js に logging 関数が追加されているはず",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "cat utils.js",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📋 動作原理",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "**Plan Modeの3段階フロー**:",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Planning**: AIがタスクを分析・計画（副作用なし）",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Approval**: 人間が計画を承認（安全ゲート）",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **Execution**: 承認済み計画を実行（実際の変更）",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "**安全保障**:",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "- 承認前はファイル変更なし",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "- 予算超過で自動停止",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "- 構造化ログで監査可能",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🚀 応用パターン",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "### 並列サブエージェント使用",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan \"Implement user authentication with tests\" --mode=orchestrated",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "### パフォーマンス競争実行",
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan \"Optimize slow database query\" --mode=competition",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "### リサーチ統合",
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan \"Add React error boundaries\" --research-depth=2",
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📚 詳細ドキュメント",
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "- [実行モード詳細](./execution-modes.md) - Orchestrated/Competitionモードの違い",
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "text": "- [スラッシュコマンド](./slash-commands.md) - 全コマンドリファレンス",
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "- [GUI操作](./gui-controls.md) - VS Code拡張での操作",
            "lineNumber": 96
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.4447605609893799
    },
    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\codex-rs\\core\\src\\plan\\mod.rs",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 43
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "//! plan mode implementation",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "//! Provides read-only planning phase with approval gates, budget enforcement,",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "//! and multiple execution strategies (single, orchestrated, competition).",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "//! ## Integration with Official Plan Mode",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "//! This custom Plan module extends the official Plan Mode collaboration template",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "//! (&#96;codex-rs/core/templates/collaboration_mode/plan.md&#96;) with advanced features",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "//! while maintaining alignment with the official 2-phase conversational approach.",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "//! ### Official Plan Mode Structure",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "//! The official Plan Mode (improved in commits #9877, #9874) uses a conversational",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "//! 2-phase approach:",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "//! 1. **PHASE 1 — Intent chat**: Understand what the user actually wants",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "//!    - Goal + success criteria, audience, in/out of scope, constraints, current state",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "//!    - Key preferences/tradeoffs",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "//!    - Bias toward questions over guessing",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "//! 2. **PHASE 2 — Implementation chat**: Technical spec and implementation plan",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "//!    - Approach, interfaces (APIs/schemas/I/O), data flow",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "//!    - Edge cases/failure modes, testing + acceptance criteria",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "//!    - Rollout/monitoring, migrations/compat constraints",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "//! ### Key Principles from Official Improvements",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Ask a lot, but never ask trivia**: Questions must materially change the spec/plan,",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "//!   confirm/lock assumptions, or choose between meaningful tradeoffs",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Batch questions**: 4-10 questions per &#96;request_user_input&#96; call to keep momentum",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Two kinds of unknowns**:",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "//!   1. Discoverable facts: Explore first (≥2 targeted searches) before asking",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "//!   2. Preferences/tradeoffs: Ask early with 2-4 options + recommended default",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Finalization rule**: Only output final plan when remaining unknowns are low-impact",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "//!   and explicitly listed as assumptions",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "//! ### Custom Plan Features",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "//! This module adds advanced capabilities beyond the official template:",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Budget management**: Token and time budgets with per-step and session caps",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Execution logging**: Detailed event-based logs of plan execution",
            "lineNumber": 43
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.4364708662033081
    },
    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\codex-rs\\core\\src\\plan\\executor.rs",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 195,
            "column": 54
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 226,
            "column": 41
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "        let started_at = Utc::now();",
            "lineNumber": 197
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 198
          },
          {
            "text": "        info!(\"Starting execution {} for Plan {}\", execution_id, plan.id);",
            "lineNumber": 199
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 200
          },
          {
            "text": "        // Transition to Executing state",
            "lineNumber": 201
          },
          {
            "text": "        plan.state = plan",
            "lineNumber": 202
          },
          {
            "text": "            .state",
            "lineNumber": 203
          },
          {
            "text": "            .clone()",
            "lineNumber": 204
          },
          {
            "text": "            .start_execution(execution_id.clone())",
            "lineNumber": 205
          },
          {
            "text": "            .context(\"Failed to transition to Executing state\")?;",
            "lineNumber": 206
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 207
          },
          {
            "text": "        plan.updated_at = Utc::now();",
            "lineNumber": 208
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 209
          },
          {
            "text": "        // Emit started event",
            "lineNumber": 210
          },
          {
            "text": "        self.emit_event(ExecutionEvent::Started {",
            "lineNumber": 211
          },
          {
            "text": "            execution_id: execution_id.clone(),",
            "lineNumber": 212
          },
          {
            "text": "            plan_id: plan.id.clone(),",
            "lineNumber": 213
          },
          {
            "text": "            timestamp: started_at,",
            "lineNumber": 214
          },
          {
            "text": "        })",
            "lineNumber": 215
          },
          {
            "text": "        .await;",
            "lineNumber": 216
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 217
          },
          {
            "text": "        // Execute the Plan",
            "lineNumber": 218
          },
          {
            "text": "        let result = match self.execute_internal(&amp;execution_id, &amp;plan).await {",
            "lineNumber": 219
          },
          {
            "text": "            Ok(orchestrated_result) =&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 220
          },
          {
            "text": "                info!(\"Execution {} completed successfully\", execution_id);",
            "lineNumber": 221
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 222
          },
          {
            "text": "                // Transition to Completed state",
            "lineNumber": 223
          },
          {
            "text": "                plan.state = plan",
            "lineNumber": 224
          },
          {
            "text": "                    .state",
            "lineNumber": 225
          },
          {
            "text": "                    .clone()",
            "lineNumber": 226
          },
          {
            "text": "                    .complete_execution()",
            "lineNumber": 227
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.43160220980644226
    },
    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\codex-rs\\core\\src\\plan\\schema.rs",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 61
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "//! Plan schema definitions",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "//! Defines the core data structures for plan mode, including the",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "//! PlanBlock which represents a complete planning artifact.",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "//! ## Alignment with Official Plan Mode",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "//! The &#96;PlanBlock&#96; structure captures the structured output from the official Plan Mode",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "//! collaboration template. Key fields align with the 2-phase approach:",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Phase 1 (Intent)**: &#96;goal&#96;, &#96;assumptions&#96;, &#96;clarifying_questions&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Phase 2 (Implementation)**: &#96;approach&#96;, &#96;work_items&#96;, &#96;risks&#96;, &#96;eval&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "//! The &#96;clarifying_questions&#96; field should contain questions that:",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - Materially change the spec/plan, OR",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - Confirm/lock an assumption, OR",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - Choose between meaningful tradeoffs",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "//! Questions should be batched (4-10 per interaction) to maintain momentum, following",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "//! the official Plan Mode improvements from commits #9877 and #9874.",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "use chrono::DateTime;",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "use chrono::Utc;",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "use serde::Deserialize;",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "use serde::Serialize;",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "use std::collections::HashMap;",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "/// Execution mode for Plan execution",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "#[serde(rename_all = \"snake_case\")]",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "pub enum ExecutionMode {",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Single agent, no orchestration",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "    Single,",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\codex-rs\\core\\src\\plan\\manager.rs",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 40,

        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "//! Plan manager",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "//! High-level API for creating, updating, approving, and exporting plan.",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "//! ## Integration with Official Plan Mode",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "//! This custom Plan module works in conjunction with the official Plan Mode collaboration",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "//! template (&#96;codex-rs/core/templates/collaboration_mode/plan.md&#96;). The official template",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "//! provides the conversational prompt structure for LLM interactions, while this module",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "//! manages the structured &#96;PlanBlock&#96; data that results from those interactions.",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "//! ### Official Plan Mode Improvements (commits #9877, #9874)",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "//! The official Plan Mode follows a 2-phase conversational approach:",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "//! **PHASE 1 — Intent chat**: Gather goal, success criteria, audience, scope, constraints,",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "//! current state, and key preferences/tradeoffs. Bias toward questions over guessing.",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "//! **PHASE 2 — Implementation chat**: Once intent is stable, gather decision-complete spec:",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "//! approach, interfaces, data flow, edge cases, testing criteria, rollout/monitoring.",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "//! Key principles:",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - Ask many questions, but only those that materially change the spec/plan",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - Batch questions (4-10) per &#96;request_user_input&#96; call",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - Explore discoverable facts first before asking",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - Ask preferences/tradeoffs early with 2-4 options + recommended default",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "//! ### Custom Plan Features",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "//! This module extends the official Plan Mode with advanced features:",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Budget management**: Token and time budgets per step and session",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Execution logging**: Detailed logs of plan execution with events",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Orchestration**: Support for single, orchestrated, and competition execution modes",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Research integration**: Deep research capabilities for plan creation",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Quality assurance**: QC analysis and quality gates",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **State management**: Drafting, approval, execution, and completion states",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "use super::persist::PlanPersister;",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "use super::policy::ApprovalRole;",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "use super::policy::PolicyEnforcer;",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "use super::policy::PrivilegedOperation;",
            "lineNumber": 41
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.4203433096408844
    },

          {
            "text": "    #[allow(non_snake_case)]",
            "lineNumber": 179
          },
          {
            "text": "    pub fn update_Plan(&amp;self, id: &amp;str, update_fn: impl FnOnce(&amp;mut PlanBlock)) -&gt; Result&lt;String&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 180
          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "            return Err(ManagerError::CannotModify {",

          },
          {
            "text": "                state: bp.state.name().to_string(),",

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },

            "lineNumber": 189
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 190
          },
          {
            "text": "        // Apply updates",
            "lineNumber": 191
          },
          {
            "text": "        update_fn(&amp;mut bp);",
            "lineNumber": 192
          },
          {
            "text": "        bp.touch();",
            "lineNumber": 193
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 194
          },
          {
            "text": "        // Save",

          },
          {
            "text": "        {",

          },
          {
            "text": "            let mut plans = self.plans.write().unwrap();",

          },
          {
            "text": "            plans.insert(bp.id.clone(), bp.clone());",

          },
          {
            "text": "        }",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 200
          },
          {
            "text": "        self.persister.save_json(&amp;bp)?;",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 202
          },
          {
            "text": "        Ok(bp.id.clone())",

          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 204
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 205
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Submit Plan for approval",
            "lineNumber": 206
          },
          {
            "text": "    pub fn submit_for_approval(&amp;self, id: &amp;str) -&gt; Result&lt;()&gt; {",

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },

          },
          {

          },
          {

          {

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 216
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 217
          },
          {
            "text": "        self.persister.save_json(&amp;bp)?;",
            "lineNumber": 218
          },
          {
            "text": "        Ok(())",
            "lineNumber": 219
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 220
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 221
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Approve a Plan",
            "lineNumber": 222
          },
          {
            "text": "    #[allow(non_snake_case)]",
            "lineNumber": 223
          },
          {
            "text": "    pub fn approve_Plan(",
            "lineNumber": 224
          },
          {
            "text": "        &amp;self,",
            "lineNumber": 225
          },

            "text": "従来のWeb検索（&#96;web_search&#96;）機能を拡張し、DeepResearch機能を統合した&#96;deep_web_search&#96;ツールを実装したで！  ",

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "codex delegate-parallel code-reviewer,test-gen --scopes ./src,./tests",
            "lineNumber": 187
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 188
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 189
          },
          {
            "text": "### 🔍 Deep Research Engine / Deep Researchエンジン",
            "lineNumber": 190
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 191
          },
          {
            "text": "**Status / 実装状況**: ✅ **Implemented / 実装済み** (v2.2.0)",
            "lineNumber": 192
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 193
          },
          {
            "text": "**English**: Multi-source research engine with citation management and contradiction detection. Integrates 15+ MCP servers and achieves 45x speedup with intelligent caching.",
            "lineNumber": 194
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 195
          },
          {
            "text": "**日本語**: 引用管理と矛盾検出機能を持つマルチソースリサーチエンジン。15以上のMCPサーバーを統合し、インテリジェントキャッシングにより45倍の高速化を実現。",
            "lineNumber": 196
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 197
          },
          {
            "text": "**Implementation / 実装**:",
            "lineNumber": 198
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Location / 場所**: &#96;codex-rs/deep-research/&#96; - Multi-source search provider",
            "lineNumber": 199
          },
          {
            "text": "- **MCP Integration / MCP統合**: &#96;codex-rs/deep-research/src/mcp_search_provider.rs&#96; - MCP-based search",
            "lineNumber": 200
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Search Providers / 検索プロバイダー**: Brave, DuckDuckGo, Google, Bing (via MCP)",
            "lineNumber": 201
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Caching / キャッシング**: TTL 1h, 45x speedup / TTL 1時間、45倍高速化",
            "lineNumber": 202
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 203
          },
          {
            "text": "**Features / 機能**:",
            "lineNumber": 204
          },
          {
            "text": "- Multi-source validation / マルチソース検証: 15+ MCP servers / 15以上のMCPサーバー",
            "lineNumber": 205
          },
          {
            "text": "- Citation management / 引用管理: Source tracking / ソース追跡",
            "lineNumber": 206
          },
          {
            "text": "- Contradiction detection / 矛盾検出: Automatic validation / 自動検証",
            "lineNumber": 207
          },
          {
            "text": "- Performance / 性能: 45x faster with cache / キャッシュで45倍高速化",
            "lineNumber": 208
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 209
          },
          {
            "text": "**Usage / 使用方法**:",
            "lineNumber": 210
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 211
          },
          {
            "text": "codex research \"Rust async best practices\" --depth 3 --strategy comprehensive",
            "lineNumber": 212
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 213
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 214
          },
          {
            "text": "### 🌌 4D Git Visualization / 4次元Git可視化",
            "lineNumber": 215
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 216
          },
          {
            "text": "**Status / 実装状況**: ✅ **Implemented / 実装済み** (v2.2.0)",
            "lineNumber": 217
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 218
          },
          {
            "text": "**English**: Revolutionary 4-dimensional Git repository visualization (xyz + time axis) that surpasses Kamui4D. CUDA-accelerated analysis processes 100,000+ commits in 0.05 seconds. Supports real-time playback, heatmap visualization, and dependency graph clustering.",
            "lineNumber": 219
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 220
          },
          {
            "text": "**日本語**: Kamui4Dを超える革新的な4次元Gitリポジトリ可視化（xyz + 時刻軸）。CUDA加速により100,000以上のコミットを0.05秒で解析。リアルタイム再生、ヒートマップ可視化、依存関係グラフクラスタリングをサポート。",
            "lineNumber": 221
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 222
          },
          {
            "text": "**Implementation / 実装**:",
            "lineNumber": 223
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Location / 場所**: &#96;codex-rs/cli/src/git_cuda.rs&#96; - CUDA-accelerated Git analysis",
            "lineNumber": 224
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.4393989145755768

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "MCP統合リサーチエンジンによる信頼性の高い調査機能。",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🎯 概要",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "Deep Researchはタスク実行前に必要な知識を自動収集し、引用付きで提供します。信頼性0.85以上の結果を保証。",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🔍 動作原理",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",

          },

          },
          {
            "text": "    ↓",

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "    ↓",

          },

            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "    ↓",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "# Rust非同期処理調査",

          },
          {

          },

          },

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "use crate::provider::ResearchProvider;",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "use crate::strategies::apply_strategy;",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "use crate::strategies::extract_findings;",

          },

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "use crate::types::DeepResearcherConfig;",

          },
          {

          },

          },

            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "/// Execute the research pipeline",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "pub async fn conduct_research(",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "    provider: Arc&lt;dyn ResearchProvider&gt;,",

          },
          {
            "text": "    config: &amp;DeepResearcherConfig,",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": ") -&gt; Result&lt;ResearchReport&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "    let mut all_sources = Vec::new();",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "    let mut depth = 0;",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Multi-depth exploration",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Note: In the current mock implementation, we only do one iteration.",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "    // A real implementation would analyze results and generate follow-up queries",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "    // for deeper exploration across multiple iterations.",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "    #[allow(clippy::never_loop)]",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "    while depth &lt; config.max_depth {",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "        depth += 1;",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "        let current_query = query.to_string();",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "        // Search for sources",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "        let sources = provider.search(&amp;current_query, config.max_sources).await?;",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "        if sources.is_empty() {",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "            break;",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "        all_sources.extend(sources);",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "        // For mock implementation, we don't do follow-up queries",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "        // In a real implementation, we would analyze results and generate new queries",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "        break;",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Apply strategy to filter and prioritize sources",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "    let filtered_sources = apply_strategy(all_sources, config.strategy, config.max_sources);",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Retrieve detailed content from sources",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "    let mut contents = Vec::new();",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "    for source in &amp;filtered_sources {",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "        match provider.retrieve(&amp;source.url).await {",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "            Ok(content) =&gt; contents.push(content),",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "            Err(_) =&gt; contents.push(String::new()),",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Extract findings from sources",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "    let findings = extract_findings(&amp;filtered_sources, &amp;contents);",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Generate summary",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "    let summary = generate_summary(&amp;findings, query, config.strategy);",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Check for contradictions",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "    let contradiction_report =",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "pub async fn run_research_command(",

          },
          {
            "text": "    topic: String,",

          },
          {
            "text": "    depth: u8,",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "    breadth: u8,",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "    budget: usize,",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "    _citations: bool,",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "    mcp_url: Option&lt;String&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "    lightweight_fallback: bool,",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "    out: Option&lt;PathBuf&gt;,",

          },
          {
            "text": "    use_gemini: bool,",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "    use_mcp: bool,",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": ") -&gt; Result&lt;()&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "    println!(\"🔍 Starting deep research on: {}\", topic);",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "    println!(\"   Depth: {}, Breadth: {}\", depth, breadth);",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "    println!(\"   Budget: {} tokens\", budget);",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "    let plan = ResearchPlanner::generate_plan(&amp;topic, depth, breadth as usize)",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "        .context(\"Failed to generate research plan\")?;",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "    println!(\"\\n📋 Research Plan:\");",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "    println!(\"   Main topic: {}\", plan.main_topic);",

          },
          {
            "text": "    println!(\"   Sub-queries ({}):\", plan.sub_queries.len());",

          },
          {
            "text": "    for (i, query) in plan.sub_queries.iter().enumerate() {",

          },
          {

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "    let actual_plan = if lightweight_fallback &amp;&amp; budget &lt; 30_000 {",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "        println!(\"\\n⚡ Using lightweight research mode due to budget constraints\");",

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "- Collaboration store / コラボレーションストア: Agent communication / エージェント間通信",
            "lineNumber": 179
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 180
          },
          {
            "text": "**Usage / 使用方法**:",
            "lineNumber": 181
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 182
          },
          {
            "text": "# Single agent / 単一エージェント",

          },
          {
            "text": "codex delegate code-reviewer --scope ./src",
            "lineNumber": 184

          {
            "lineNumber": 185
          },
          {
            "text": "# Parallel agents / 並列エージェント",
            "lineNumber": 186
          },
          {
            "text": "codex delegate-parallel code-reviewer,test-gen --scopes ./src,./tests",
            "lineNumber": 187
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 188
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 189
          },
          {
            "text": "### 🔍 Deep Research Engine / Deep Researchエンジン",
            "lineNumber": 190
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 191
          },
          {
            "text": "**Status / 実装状況**: ✅ **Implemented / 実装済み** (v2.2.0)",
            "lineNumber": 192
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 193
          },
          {
            "text": "**English**: Multi-source research engine with citation management and contradiction detection. Integrates 15+ MCP servers and achieves 45x speedup with intelligent caching.",
            "lineNumber": 194
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 195
          },
          {
            "text": "**日本語**: 引用管理と矛盾検出機能を持つマルチソースリサーチエンジン。15以上のMCPサーバーを統合し、インテリジェントキャッシングにより45倍の高速化を実現。",
            "lineNumber": 196
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 197
          },
          {
            "text": "**Implementation / 実装**:",
            "lineNumber": 198
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Location / 場所**: &#96;codex-rs/deep-research/&#96; - Multi-source search provider",
            "lineNumber": 199
          },
          {
            "text": "- **MCP Integration / MCP統合**: &#96;codex-rs/deep-research/src/mcp_search_provider.rs&#96; - MCP-based search",
            "lineNumber": 200
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Search Providers / 検索プロバイダー**: Brave, DuckDuckGo, Google, Bing (via MCP)",
            "lineNumber": 201
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Caching / キャッシング**: TTL 1h, 45x speedup / TTL 1時間、45倍高速化",
            "lineNumber": 202
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 203
          },
          {
            "text": "**Features / 機能**:",
            "lineNumber": 204
          },
          {
            "text": "- Multi-source validation / マルチソース検証: 15+ MCP servers / 15以上のMCPサーバー",
            "lineNumber": 205
          },
          {
            "text": "- Citation management / 引用管理: Source tracking / ソース追跡",
            "lineNumber": 206
          },
          {
            "text": "- Contradiction detection / 矛盾検出: Automatic validation / 自動検証",
            "lineNumber": 207
          },
          {
            "text": "- Performance / 性能: 45x faster with cache / キャッシュで45倍高速化",
            "lineNumber": 208
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 209
          },
          {
            "text": "**Usage / 使用方法**:",
            "lineNumber": 210
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 211
          },
          {
            "text": "codex research \"Rust async best practices\" --depth 3 --strategy comprehensive",
            "lineNumber": 212
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 213
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 214
          },
          {
            "text": "### 🌌 4D Git Visualization / 4次元Git可視化",
            "lineNumber": 215
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 216
          },
          {
            "text": "**Status / 実装状況**: ✅ **Implemented / 実装済み** (v2.2.0)",
            "lineNumber": 217
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 218
          },
          {
            "text": "**English**: Revolutionary 4-dimensional Git repository visualization (xyz + time axis) that surpasses Kamui4D. CUDA-accelerated analysis processes 100,000+ commits in 0.05 seconds. Supports real-time playback, heatmap visualization, and dependency graph clustering.",
            "lineNumber": 219
          },
          {

          {
            "text": "**日本語**: Kamui4Dを超える革新的な4次元Gitリポジトリ可視化（xyz + 時刻軸）。CUDA加速により100,000以上のコミットを0.05秒で解析。リアルタイム再生、ヒートマップ可視化、依存関係グラフクラスタリングをサポート。",

          {

          },
          {

          {

          {

          {

          },
          {

          },

          {

          },
          {
            "text": "    let config = DeepResearcherConfig {",

          },
          {
            "text": "        max_depth: plan.stop_conditions.max_depth,",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "        max_sources: plan.stop_conditions.max_sources as u8,",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "        strategy: ResearchStrategy::Comprehensive,",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "    };",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "    let researcher = DeepResearcher::new(config, provider);",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "    let report = researcher",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "        .research(&amp;query)",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "        .await",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "        .context(\"Failed to conduct research\")?;",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Convert report to JSON",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "    Ok(serde_json::json!({",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "        \"query\": report.query,",

          },
          {
            "text": "        \"summary\":",

            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "use codex_core::chrome::parse_nl_command;",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "use codex_deep_research::DeepResearcher;",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "use codex_deep_research::DeepResearcherConfig;",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "use codex_deep_research::ResearchPlanner;",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "use codex_deep_research::ResearchStrategy;",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "use codex_deep_research::provider::ResearchProvider;",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "use codex_web_search::WebSearchProvider;",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "use std::sync::Arc;",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "/// Handle deep research request from Chrome extension",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "pub async fn handle_deep_research(",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "    query: String,",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "    depth: Option&lt;u8&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "    breadth: Option&lt;u8&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": ") -&gt; Result&lt;serde_json::Value&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "    let depth = depth.unwrap_or(3);",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "    let breadth = breadth.unwrap_or(10);",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "    let plan = ResearchPlanner::generate_plan(&amp;query, depth, breadth as usize)",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "        .context(\"Failed to generate research plan\")?;",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Use WebSearchProvider as default (no API key required)",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "    let provider: Arc&lt;dyn ResearchProvider + Send + Sync&gt; = Arc::new(WebSearchProvider::new(3, 30));",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "    let config = DeepResearcherConfig {",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "        max_depth: plan.stop_conditions.max_depth,",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "        max_sources: plan.stop_conditions.max_sources as u8,",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "        strategy: ResearchStrategy::Comprehensive,",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "    };",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "    let researcher = DeepResearcher::new(config, provider);",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "    let report = researcher",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "        .research(&amp;query)",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "        .await",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "        .context(\"Failed to conduct research\")?;",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Convert report to JSON",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "    Ok(serde_json::json!({",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "        \"query\": report.query,",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "        \"summary\":",
            "lineNumber": 45
          }
        ]
