          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🎯 概要",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "Codex Deep Researchは、**OpenAI/codexのWeb検索機能**と**DuckDuckGo HTMLスクレイピング**を統合した高度な調査ツールです。",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "### ✨ 主な特徴",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "- 🔓 **APIキー不要**: DuckDuckGoによりゼロコストで即座に利用可能",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "- 🤖 **Gemini CLI統合**: Google Search + Gemini AIによる高品質検索 🆕",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "- 🔄 **3段階フォールバック**: 商用API → DuckDuckGo → 公式フォーマット",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "- 🌐 **複数バックエンド対応**: Gemini CLI, Brave, Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "- 🎯 **計画的調査**: サブクエリ分解 → 多段探索 → 矛盾検出",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "- 📊 **引用必須レポート**: Markdown形式で完全な引用付きレポート生成",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "---",

          },

            "lineNumber": 38
          },

          },

            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "#### DuckDuckGo（デフォルト・APIキー不要）",

          },

            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",

          },
          {
            "text": "use codex_deep_research::WebSearchProvider;",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "let provider = WebSearchProvider::default();",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "let results = provider.duckduckgo_search_real(\"Rust async programming\", 5).await?;",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "**特徴**:",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ 完全無料（APIキー不要）",

          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ 即座に利用可能",

          {
            "text": "impl McpSearchProvider {",

          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "### 利用可能なエージェント",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Backend Agent**: API、データベース、サーバーサイドロジック",

          },
          {
            "text": "- **Frontend Agent**: UI/UX、React、CSS、JavaScript",
            "lineNumber": 26

          {

            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Security Agent**: 脆弱性スキャン、認証・認可、安全なコーディング",

          },
          {
            "text": "- **QA Agent**: テスト生成、品質チェック、バグ検出",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🚀 基本使用法",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "### 単一エージェント実行",

          },

          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "codex delegate backend-agent --scope ./src",

          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "# Security Agentでコードレビュー",

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "### 並列実行 (2.6x speedup)",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "# 複数エージェントの並列実行",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "codex delegate-parallel backend-agent,frontend-agent,database-agent \\",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {

          },

        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "このセクションでは、[@zapabob](https://github.com/zapabob)が元の[OpenAI/codex](https://github.com/openai/codex)プロジェクトに追加した独自機能と拡張を紹介します。",
            "lineNumber": 159
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 160
          },
          {
            "text": "### 🤖 Sub-Agent System / サブエージェントシステム",
            "lineNumber": 161
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 162
          },
          {
            "text": "**Status / 実装状況**: ✅ **Implemented / 実装済み** (v2.2.0)",
            "lineNumber": 163
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 164
          },
          {
            "text": "**English**: A powerful multi-agent orchestration system that enables parallel execution of specialized AI agents. Supports 8+ predefined agents (code-reviewer, test-gen, sec-audit, deep-researcher) and custom YAML-defined agents. Achieves 2.6x speedup through parallel execution.",
            "lineNumber": 165
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 166
          },
          {
            "text": "**日本語**: 専門AIエージェントの並列実行を可能にする強力なマルチエージェントオーケストレーションシステム。8種類以上の定義済みエージェント（code-reviewer、test-gen、sec-audit、deep-researcher）とカスタムYAML定義エージェントをサポート。並列実行により2.6倍の高速化を実現。",
            "lineNumber": 167
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 168
          },
          {
            "text": "**Implementation / 実装**:",
            "lineNumber": 169
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Location / 場所**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/agents/&#96; - AgentRuntime, AgentLoader, PermissionChecker",
            "lineNumber": 170
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Agent Definitions / エージェント定義**: &#96;.codex/agents/*.yaml&#96; - YAML-driven configuration",
            "lineNumber": 171
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Parallel Execution / 並列実行**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/async_subagent_integration.rs&#96; - AsyncSubAgentIntegration",
            "lineNumber": 172
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Token Budget / トークン予算**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/token_budget.rs&#96; - Per-agent limits",
            "lineNumber": 173
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 174
          },
          {
            "text": "**Features / 機能**:",
            "lineNumber": 175
          },
          {
            "text": "- Parallel execution / 並列実行: 2.6x faster / 2.6倍高速化",
            "lineNumber": 176
          },
          {
            "text": "- Custom agent creation / カスタムエージェント作成: YAML-driven / YAML駆動",
            "lineNumber": 177
          },
          {
            "text": "- Conflict resolution / コンフリクト解決: 3 merge strategies / 3種類のマージ戦略",
            "lineNumber": 178
          },
          {
            "text": "- Collaboration store / コラボレーションストア: Agent communication / エージェント間通信",
            "lineNumber": 179
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 180
          },
          {
            "text": "**Usage / 使用方法**:",
            "lineNumber": 181
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 182
          },
          {
            "text": "# Single agent / 単一エージェント",
            "lineNumber": 183
          },
          {
            "text": "codex delegate code-reviewer --scope ./src",
            "lineNumber": 184
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 185
          },
          {
            "text": "# Parallel agents / 並列エージェント",
            "lineNumber": 186
          },
          {
            "text": "codex delegate-parallel code-reviewer,test-gen --scopes ./src,./tests",
            "lineNumber": 187
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 188
          }
        ]

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\codex-rs\\core\\src\\agents\\runtime.rs",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {

          },

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "    pub async fn delegate_parallel(",
            "lineNumber": 120
          },
          {
            "text": "        &amp;self,",
            "lineNumber": 121
          },
          {
            "text": "        agents: Vec&lt;(String, String, HashMap&lt;String, String&gt;, Option&lt;usize&gt;)&gt;, // (agent_name, goal, inputs, budget)",
            "lineNumber": 122
          },
          {
            "text": "        deadline: Option&lt;u64&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 123
          },
          {
            "text": "    ) -&gt; Result&lt;Vec&lt;AgentResult&gt;&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 124
          },
          {
            "text": "        use super::parallel_executor::{ParallelExecutor, ParallelExecutorConfig, AgentTask};",
            "lineNumber": 125
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 126
          },
          {
            "text": "        info!(\"Starting parallel delegation of {} agents\", agents.len());",
            "lineNumber": 127
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 128
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 並列実行設定",
            "lineNumber": 129
          },
          {
            "text": "        let timeout = deadline.map(|d| Duration::from_secs(d));",
            "lineNumber": 130
          },
          {
            "text": "        let config = ParallelExecutorConfig {",
            "lineNumber": 131
          },
          {
            "text": "            max_concurrent: 4, // デフォルトは4並列",
            "lineNumber": 132
          },
          {
            "text": "            timeout,",
            "lineNumber": 133
          },
          {
            "text": "            progress_tx: None, // 必要に応じて進捗通知を追加可能",
            "lineNumber": 134
          },
          {
            "text": "            memory_limit_mb: None,",
            "lineNumber": 135
          },
          {
            "text": "        };",
            "lineNumber": 136
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 137
          },
          {
            "text": "        let executor = ParallelExecutor::new(config);",
            "lineNumber": 138
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 139
          },
          {
            "text": "        // エージェントタスクを作成",
            "lineNumber": 140
          },
          {
            "text": "        let tasks: Vec&lt;AgentTask&gt; = agents",
            "lineNumber": 141
          },
          {
            "text": "            .into_iter()",
            "lineNumber": 142
          },
          {
            "text": "            .map(|(agent_name, goal, inputs, budget)| {",
            "lineNumber": 143
          },
          {
            "text": "                let runtime_clone = Arc::new(self.clone_for_parallel());",
            "lineNumber": 144
          },
          {
            "text": "                let agent_name_clone = agent_name.clone();",
            "lineNumber": 145
          },
          {
            "text": "                let goal_clone = goal.clone();",
            "lineNumber": 146
          },
          {
            "text": "                let inputs_clone = inputs.clone();",
            "lineNumber": 147
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 148
          },
          {
            "text": "                AgentTask {",
            "lineNumber": 149
          },
          {
            "text": "                    agent_name: agent_name_clone.clone(),",
            "lineNumber": 150
          },
          {
            "text": "                    executor: Box::new(move || {",
            "lineNumber": 151
          },
          {
            "text": "                        let runtime = runtime_clone.clone();",
            "lineNumber": 152
          },
          {
            "text": "                        let agent_name = agent_name_clone.clone();",
            "lineNumber": 153
          },
          {
            "text": "                        let goal = goal_clone.clone();",
            "lineNumber": 154
          },
          {
            "text": "                        let inputs = inputs_clone.clone();",
            "lineNumber": 155
          },
          {
            "text": "                        let budget = budget;",
            "lineNumber": 156
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 157
          },
          {
            "text": "                        Box::pin(async move {",
            "lineNumber": 158
          },
          {
            "text": "                            runtime",
            "lineNumber": 159
          },
          {
            "text": "                                .delegate(&amp;agent_name, &amp;goal, inputs, budget, None)",
            "lineNumber": 160
          },
          {
            "text": "                                .await",
            "lineNumber": 161
          },
          {
            "text": "                        })",
            "lineNumber": 162
          },
          {
            "text": "                    }),",
            "lineNumber": 163
          },
          {
            "text": "                }",
            "lineNumber": 164
          },
          {
            "text": "            })",
            "lineNumber": 165
          },
          {
            "text": "            .collect();",
            "lineNumber": 166
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 167
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 並列実行",
            "lineNumber": 168
          },
          {
            "text": "        executor.execute_parallel(tasks).await",
            "lineNumber": 169
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 170
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.4961495101451874
    },

      "codeBlock": {

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# サブエージェント・DeepResearch機能実装ログ",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "**日時**: 2025年10月7日 23:40 JST  ",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "**作業者**: AI Assistant (なんJ風)  ",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "**目的**: Claudecode/gemini-cli風のサブエージェント機能とDeepResearch機能を実装・テスト",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "参考リポジトリ: https://github.com/zapabob/gemini-cli",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📋 実装概要",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "gemini-cliを参考に、複数のサブエージェントが協調して動作するシステムと、深層研究（Deep Research）機能を強化したで！  ",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "既存の&#96;supervisor&#96;と&#96;deep-research&#96;クレートを活用しつつ、新しいモジュールを追加して統合や。",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🎯 実装した機能",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. サブエージェント通信システム (&#96;subagent.rs&#96;)",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "**場所**: &#96;codex-rs/supervisor/src/subagent.rs&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 主要機能",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "##### エージェントタイプ（8種類）",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "- **CodeExpert**: コード分析・生成専門",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "- **SecurityExpert**: セキュリティレビュー専門",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "- **TestingExpert**: テスト生成専門",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "- **DocsExpert**: ドキュメント生成専門",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "- **DeepResearcher**: 深層研究専門",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "- **DebugExpert**: デバッグ専門",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "- **PerformanceExpert**: パフォーマンス最適化専門",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "- **General**: 汎用エージェント",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "##### エージェント間通信",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "pub struct AgentMessage {",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "    pub from: AgentType,",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "    pub to: Option&lt;AgentType&gt;, // None = ブロードキャスト",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "    pub content: String,",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "    pub metadata: HashMap&lt;String, String&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "##### エージェント状態管理",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "pub struct AgentState {",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "    pub agent_type: AgentType,",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "    pub status: AgentStatus, // Idle, Working, Waiting, Completed, Failed",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "    pub current_task: Option&lt;String&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "    pub progress: f32, // 0.0-1.0",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "##### サブエージェント管理",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "pub struct SubAgentManager {",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "    agents: HashMap&lt;AgentType, SubAgent&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "- エージェントの登録・管理",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "- タスクのディスパッチ",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "- ブロードキャストメッセージング",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "- 状態監視",
            "lineNumber": 67
          }
        ]
      },

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\zapabob\\OPENAI_PR_差異まとめ.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 71
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# OpenAI/codex との差異まとめ",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "**作成日**: 2025年10月12日  ",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "**対象ブランチ**: &#96;feat/openai-pr-preparation&#96;  ",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "**ターゲット**: &#96;openai/codex:main&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🎯 概要",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "zapabob/codex は OpenAI/codex の公式フォークであり、以下の **本番環境対応の独自機能** を追加しています。",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "## ⚡ 主要な差異（zapabob/codex 独自機能）",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. **並列エージェント実行** (&#96;delegate-parallel&#96;)",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "**OpenAI/codex**: ❌ なし（シングルスレッド非同期のみ）  ",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "**zapabob/codex**: ✅ &#96;tokio::spawn&#96; による真のマルチスレッド並列実行",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "# 複数エージェントを並列実行",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "codex delegate-parallel code-reviewer,test-gen \\",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "  --goals \"セキュリティレビュー,テスト生成\" \\",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "  --budgets \"5000,3000\"",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "**効果**: 逐次実行と比較して **2.5倍高速**",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. **動的エージェント生成** (&#96;agent-create&#96;)",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "**OpenAI/codex**: ❌ なし（静的YAMLのみ）  ",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "**zapabob/codex**: ✅ LLM経由で実行時にエージェント生成",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "# 自然言語プロンプトからエージェント生成",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "codex agent-create \"セキュリティ脆弱性をスキャンするエージェントを作成\" \\",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "  --budget 10000 \\",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "  --save",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "**効果**: YAML設定不要、**無限の柔軟性**",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "### 3. **メタオーケストレーション**",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "**OpenAI/codex**: ❌ なし（自己参照なし）  ",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "**zapabob/codex**: ✅ MCP経由でCodexが自分自身をサブエージェントとして使用",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "**効果**: **再帰的AIシステム**による無限の拡張性",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "### 4. **トークン予算管理** (&#96;TokenBudgeter&#96;)",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "**OpenAI/codex**: ❌ なし  ",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "**zapabob/codex**: ✅ エージェント毎のトークン追跡と制限",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "**効果**: **コスト管理**と公平なリソース配分",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "### 5. **包括的監査ログ** (&#96;AgentExecutionEvent&#96;)",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "**OpenAI/codex**: ❌ 基本ログのみ  ",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "**zapabob/codex**: ✅ 構造化された実行イベントログ",
            "lineNumber": 70
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.47207310795783997
    },
    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\codex-rs\\core\\src\\orchestration\\parallel_execution.rs",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 105,
            "column": 66
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 146,
            "column": 54
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": " Result&lt;Vec&lt;AgentResult&gt;&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 106
          },
          {
            "text": "        let mut handles: Vec&lt;JoinHandle&lt;AgentResult&gt;&gt; = Vec::new();",
            "lineNumber": 107
          },
          {
            "text": "        let mut guards: Vec&lt;ResourceGuard&gt; = Vec::new();",
            "lineNumber": 108
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 109
          },
          {
            "text": "        // Acquire resource slots for all tasks",
            "lineNumber": 110
          },
          {
            "text": "        for _ in 0..tasks.len() {",
            "lineNumber": 111
          },
          {
            "text": "            let guard = self.resource_manager.acquire_slot().await?;",
            "lineNumber": 112
          },
          {
            "text": "            guards.push(guard);",
            "lineNumber": 113
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 114
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 115
          },
          {
            "text": "        // Create worktrees for each agent task",
            "lineNumber": 116
          },
          {
            "text": "        let worktree_manager = WorktreeManager::new(&amp;self.repo_path)?;",
            "lineNumber": 117
          },
          {
            "text": "        let mut worktrees: Vec&lt;WorktreeInfo&gt; = Vec::new();",
            "lineNumber": 118
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 119
          },
          {
            "text": "        for task in &amp;tasks {",
            "lineNumber": 120
          },
          {
            "text": "            let task_id = Uuid::new_v4().to_string();",
            "lineNumber": 121
          },
          {
            "text": "            let agent_name = format!(\"{:?}\", task.agent).to_lowercase();",
            "lineNumber": 122
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 123
          },
          {
            "text": "            match worktree_manager.create_worktree(&amp;agent_name, &amp;task_id) {",
            "lineNumber": 124
          },
          {
            "text": "                Ok(worktree) =&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 125
          },
          {
            "text": "                    worktrees.push(worktree);",
            "lineNumber": 126
          },
          {
            "text": "                }",
            "lineNumber": 127
          },
          {
            "text": "                Err(e) =&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 128
          },
          {
            "text": "                    tracing::warn!(\"Failed to create worktree for {}: {}\", agent_name, e);",
            "lineNumber": 129
          },
          {
            "text": "                    // Use repo_path as fallback",
            "lineNumber": 130
          },
          {
            "text": "                    worktrees.push(WorktreeInfo {",
            "lineNumber": 131
          },
          {
            "text": "                        name: format!(\"{agent_name}_{task_id}\"),",
            "lineNumber": 132
          },
          {
            "text": "                        path: self.repo_path.clone(),",
            "lineNumber": 133
          },
          {
            "text": "                        branch: \"main\".to_string(),",
            "lineNumber": 134
          },
          {
            "text": "                        agent: agent_name,",
            "lineNumber": 135
          },
          {
            "text": "                    });",
            "lineNumber": 136
          },
          {
            "text": "                }",
            "lineNumber": 137
          },
          {
            "text": "            }",
            "lineNumber": 138
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 139
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 140
          },
          {
            "text": "        // Store worktrees for cleanup",
            "lineNumber": 141
          },
          {
            "text": "        {",
            "lineNumber": 142
          },
          {
            "text": "            let mut cleanup = self.worktree_cleanup.write().await;",
            "lineNumber": 143
          },
          {
            "text": "            cleanup.extend(worktrees.iter().cloned());",
            "lineNumber": 144
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 145
          },
          {

          },

            "lineNumber": 147
          }
        ]

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\.cursor\\rules.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 182
          },

            "line": 266
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "❌ **NEVER** disable approval in untrusted environments  ",
            "lineNumber": 183
          },
          {
            "text": "❌ **NEVER** execute shell commands without sandboxing",
            "lineNumber": 184
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 185
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 186
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 187
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🤖 Sub-Agent System",
            "lineNumber": 188
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 189
          },
          {
            "text": "### Available Agents",
            "lineNumber": 190
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 191
          },
          {
            "text": "| Agent | Purpose | Token Budget | Scope |",
            "lineNumber": 192
          },
          {
            "text": "|-------|---------|--------------|-------|",
            "lineNumber": 193
          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;code-reviewer&#96; | Security, performance, best practices | 40,000 | TypeScript, Python, Rust, C# Unity |",
            "lineNumber": 194
          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;test-gen&#96; | Unit/Integration/E2E test generation | 30,000 | 80%+ coverage goal |",
            "lineNumber": 195
          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;sec-audit&#96; | CVE scanning, dependency audit | 50,000 | All dependencies |",
            "lineNumber": 196
          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;researcher&#96; | Deep research with citations | 60,000 | Multi-source validation |",
            "lineNumber": 197
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 198
          },
          {
            "text": "### Usage",
            "lineNumber": 199
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 200
          },
          {
            "text": "#### Single Agent",
            "lineNumber": 201
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 202
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 203
          },
          {
            "text": "# Code review",
            "lineNumber": 204
          },
          {
            "text": "codex delegate code-reviewer --scope ./src",
            "lineNumber": 205
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 206
          },
          {
            "text": "# Test generation",
            "lineNumber": 207
          },
          {
            "text": "codex delegate test-gen --scope ./tests --budget 30000",
            "lineNumber": 208
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 209
          },
          {
            "text": "# Security audit",
            "lineNumber": 210
          },
          {
            "text": "codex delegate sec-audit --scope ./package.json",
            "lineNumber": 211
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 212
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 213
          },
          {
            "text": "#### Parallel Execution (3x faster!)",
            "lineNumber": 214
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 215
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 216
          },
          {
            "text": "# Review + Test + Security in parallel",
            "lineNumber": 217
          },
          {
            "text": "codex delegate-parallel code-reviewer,test-gen,sec-audit \\",
            "lineNumber": 218
          },
          {
            "text": "  --goals \"Review code,Generate tests,Security audit\" \\",
            "lineNumber": 219
          },
          {
            "text": "  --scopes ./src,./tests,./package.json \\",
            "lineNumber": 220
          },
          {
            "text": "  --budgets 40000,30000,20000",
            "lineNumber": 221
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 222
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 223
          },
          {
            "text": "#### Custom Agent Creation",
            "lineNumber": 224
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 225
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 226
          },
          {
            "text": "# Create agent from natural language",
            "lineNumber": 227
          },
          {
            "text": "codex agent-create \"Find all TODO comments and create a summary report\" \\",
            "lineNumber": 228
          },
          {
            "text": "  --budget 50000",
            "lineNumber": 229
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 230
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 231
          },
          {
            "text": "### Agent Definition (YAML)",
            "lineNumber": 232
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 233
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;yaml",
            "lineNumber": 234
          },
          {
            "text": "# .codex/agents/code-reviewer.yaml",
            "lineNumber": 235
          },
          {
            "text": "name: code-reviewer",
            "lineNumber": 236
          },
          {
            "text": "version: \"1.0.0\"",
            "lineNumber": 237
          },
          {
            "text": "description: \"Multi-language code reviewer with security focus\"",
            "lineNumber": 238
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 239
          },
          {
            "text": "capabilities:",
            "lineNumber": 240
          },
          {
            "text": "  languages:",
            "lineNumber": 241
          },
          {
            "text": "    - typescript",
            "lineNumber": 242
          },
          {
            "text": "    - python",
            "lineNumber": 243
          },
          {
            "text": "    - rust",
            "lineNumber": 244
          },
          {
            "text": "    - csharp_unity",
            "lineNumber": 245
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 246
          },
          {
            "text": "checks:",
            "lineNumber": 247
          },
          {
            "text": "  - type_safety",
            "lineNumber": 248
          },
          {
            "text": "  - security_vulnerabilities",
            "lineNumber": 249
          },
          {
            "text": "  - performance_optimization",
            "lineNumber": 250
          },
          {
            "text": "  - best_practices",
            "lineNumber": 251
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 252
          },
          {
            "text": "token_budget: 40000",
            "lineNumber": 253
          },
          {
            "text": "sandbox_mode: read-only",
            "lineNumber": 254
          },
          {
            "text": "approval_policy: never  # Auto-approve for reviews",
            "lineNumber": 255
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 256
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 257
          },
          {
            "text": "### Best Practices",
            "lineNumber": 258
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 259
          },
          {
            "text": "✅ **Specialize**: Use dedicated agents for specific tasks  ",
            "lineNumber": 260
          },
          {
            "text": "✅ **Parallelize**: Run independent agents concurrently  ",
            "lineNumber": 261
          },
          {
            "text": "✅ **Budget**: Set appropriate token limits  ",
            "lineNumber": 262
          },
          {
            "text": "✅ **Isolate**: Each agent runs in separate process",
            "lineNumber": 263
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 264
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 265
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.47009238600730896

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\zapabob\\2025-10-12_並列実行カスタムエージェント完全実装完了.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 67
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# 並列実行・カスタムエージェント機能 完全実装完了レポート",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "**作成日時**: 2025-10-12 00:12:20 JST  ",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "**実装バージョン**: codex-cli 0.47.0-alpha.1  ",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "**ステータス**: ✅ 完全実装完了",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📋 実装概要",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "### 実装機能",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **並列エージェント実行** (&#96;delegate-parallel&#96;)",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "   - 複数のサブエージェントを並列（tokio::spawn）で非同期実行",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "   - 各エージェントに個別のゴール・予算・スコープを指定可能",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "   - 実行結果の集約とレポート生成",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **カスタムエージェント作成** (&#96;agent-create&#96;)",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "   - 自然言語プロンプトからエージェント定義をLLMが自動生成",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "   - 生成したエージェントをインライン実行（ファイル保存不要）",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "   - 実行結果のJSON出力機能",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🔧 実装ファイル",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "### Core Runtime実装",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "**ファイル**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/agents/runtime.rs&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 1. &#96;delegate_parallel&#96; 関数",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "pub async fn delegate_parallel(",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "    &amp;self,",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "    agents: Vec&lt;String&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "    goals: Vec&lt;String&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "    scopes: Vec&lt;Option&lt;PathBuf&gt;&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "    budgets: Vec&lt;Option&lt;usize&gt;&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "    deadline: Option&lt;u64&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": ") -&gt; Result&lt;Vec&lt;AgentExecutionResult&gt;&gt;",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "**主要機能**:",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;tokio::spawn&#96;による並列実行",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "- 各エージェントの独立した実行コンテキスト",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "- エラーハンドリングとタイムアウト管理",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "- 実行結果の集約",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "**実装ポイント**:",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;agent_name.clone()&#96; でムーブエラー回避",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;Arc&lt;Self&gt;&#96; でランタイムを共有",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "- 各タスクの独立性確保",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 2. &#96;create_and_run_custom_agent&#96; 関数",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "pub async fn create_and_run_custom_agent(",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "    &amp;self,",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "    prompt: &amp;str,",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "    goal: &amp;str,",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "    scope: Option&lt;PathBuf&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "    budget: Option&lt;usize&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "    deadline: Option&lt;u64&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": ") -&gt; Result&lt;AgentExecutionResult&gt;",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "**主要機能**:",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "- LLMによるエージェント定義自動生成",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "- JSON形式での定義パース",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "- インライン実行（ファイルI/O不要）",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "**LLMプロンプト設計**:",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "You are an AI agent definition generator.",
            "lineNumber": 67
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.468535840511322
    },

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\zapabob\\implementation-logs\\2025-10-07_サブエージェント・DeepResearch実装.md",

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# サブエージェント・DeepResearch機能実装ログ",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "**日時**: 2025年10月7日 23:40 JST  ",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "**作業者**: AI Assistant (なんJ風)  ",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "**目的**: Claudecode/gemini-cli風のサブエージェント機能とDeepResearch機能を実装・テスト",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "参考リポジトリ: https://github.com/zapabob/gemini-cli",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📋 実装概要",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "gemini-cliを参考に、複数のサブエージェントが協調して動作するシステムと、深層研究（Deep Research）機能を強化したで！  ",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "既存の&#96;supervisor&#96;と&#96;deep-research&#96;クレートを活用しつつ、新しいモジュールを追加して統合や。",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🎯 実装した機能",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. サブエージェント通信システム (&#96;subagent.rs&#96;)",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "**場所**: &#96;codex-rs/supervisor/src/subagent.rs&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 主要機能",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "##### エージェントタイプ（8種類）",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "- **CodeExpert**: コード分析・生成専門",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "- **SecurityExpert**: セキュリティレビュー専門",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "- **TestingExpert**: テスト生成専門",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "- **DocsExpert**: ドキュメント生成専門",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "- **DeepResearcher**: 深層研究専門",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "- **DebugExpert**: デバッグ専門",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "- **PerformanceExpert**: パフォーマンス最適化専門",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "- **General**: 汎用エージェント",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "##### エージェント間通信",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "pub struct AgentMessage {",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "    pub from: AgentType,",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "    pub to: Option&lt;AgentType&gt;, // None = ブロードキャスト",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "    pub content: String,",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "    pub metadata: HashMap&lt;String, String&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "##### エージェント状態管理",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "pub struct AgentState {",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "    pub agent_type: AgentType,",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "    pub status: AgentStatus, // Idle, Working, Waiting, Completed, Failed",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "    pub current_task: Option&lt;String&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "    pub progress: f32, // 0.0-1.0",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "##### サブエージェント管理",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "pub struct SubAgentManager {",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "    agents: HashMap&lt;AgentType, SubAgent&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "- エージェントの登録・管理",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "- タスクのディスパッチ",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "- ブロードキャストメッセージング",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "- 状態監視",
            "lineNumber": 67
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.4679432511329651

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\tools\\orchestrator\\README.md",
        "range": {

        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Codex Agents SDK Orchestrator",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## Overview",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "**Official OpenAI Codex Agents SDK Orchestrator** - Multi-agent workflow supervisor that coordinates specialized skills for complex task execution. Implements the official Skills + Agents SDK architecture pattern.",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "## Architecture",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "┌─────────────────┐    ┌──────────────────┐",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "│   Supervisor    │────│   Codex MCP      │",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "│   Orchestrator  │    │   Server         │",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "└─────────────────┘    └──────────────────┘",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "         │                        │",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "         ├────────────────────────┤",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "         │                        │",

            "text": "zapabob/codex の中央集権型 AI オーケストレーションおよび Git worktree 並列開発において、メインマージ直前の品質保証を一貫化するための運用仕様です。",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "## 1. QC Optimizer サブエージェントの役割",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "| 項目 | 内容 |",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "| --- | --- |",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "| エージェント名 | &#96;qc-optimizer&#96; |",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "| 主目的 | 単体/ユニット/異常系/包括的テストを実施し、統計・QC 観点でコード品質とアーキテクチャを評価。量子/数理最適化の観点でリスクを最小化し、メインマージ判断を可視化する。 |",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "| 主要アウトプット | 1) テストスイート実行結果、2) 問題点の可視化レポート、3) QC/統計/量子最適化の結論、4) &#96;_doc/*.md&#96; に残す実装ログ |",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "| 主なツール | &#96;cargo&#96;, &#96;npm&#96;, &#96;just&#96;, &#96;git&#96;, &#96;scripts/create-implementation-log.js&#96;, Codex MCP ファイル/検索ツール |",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "## 2. オーケストレーション手順",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **タスク解析**: Plan/TaskAnalyzer が worktree 単位にタスクを分割し、複雑度 0.7 以上の案件は自動的に &#96;qc-optimizer&#96; を含む並列フローに昇格。",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **開発サブエージェントの作業**: executor/refactorer などがコード変更を行い、PR 前に &#96;qc-optimizer&#96; に制御を移譲。",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **テストマトリクス実行**:",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "   - &#96;cargo test -p &lt;crate&gt;&#96; / &#96;cargo test --all-features&#96;（必要に応じて）",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "   - &#96;npm test&#96; / &#96;pnpm test&#96;（GUI, website, prism-web 等）",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "   - &#96;just fmt&#96;/&#96;just fix -p &lt;project&gt;&#96; による Lint 修復",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "   - シナリオ/異常系テスト、snapshot テスト",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "4. **統計・量子最適化評価**:",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "   - 失敗率、カバレッジ、実行時間、リソース消費を統計的に評価。",
            "lineNumber": 24
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.42149409651756287

          },

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 504
          },
          {

          },

          },

          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Send message with reliability and security",

          },

            "text": "//! File edit conflict resolution for multi-agent orchestration.",

            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "//! Provides mechanisms to track and resolve conflicts when multiple agents",

          },
          {
            "text": "//! attempt to edit the same files concurrently.",
            "lineNumber": 4

            "lineNumber": 5

          },

          },

          },
          {

          },
          {

          {

            "lineNumber": 48
          },

          {
            "text": "class ConflictPreventionEngine:",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 469
          },
          {
            "text": "    def coordinate_agents(self, analysis: MergeAnalysis) -&gt; Dict[str, Any]:",
            "lineNumber": 470
          },
          {
            "text": "        \"\"\"Coordinate multiple agents for conflict resolution\"\"\"",
            "lineNumber": 471
          },
          {
            "text": "        coordination_plan = {",
            "lineNumber": 472
          },
          {
            "text": "            \"agents_needed\": [],",
            "lineNumber": 473
          },
          {
            "text": "            \"terminal_assignments\": {},",
            "lineNumber": 474
          },
          {
            "text": "            \"conflict_resolution_strategy\": {},",
            "lineNumber": 475
          },
          {
            "text": "            \"communication_channels\": []",
            "lineNumber": 476
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 477
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 478
          },
          {
            "text": "        # Determine which agents are needed based on conflict types",
            "lineNumber": 479
          },
          {
            "text": "        agent_requirements = self._determine_agent_requirements(analysis.conflict_predictions)",
            "lineNumber": 480
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 481
          },
          {
            "text": "        for agent_type, needed in agent_requirements.items():",
            "lineNumber": 482
          },
          {
            "text": "            if needed:",
            "lineNumber": 483
          },
          {
            "text": "                coordination_plan[\"agents_needed\"].append(agent_type)",
            "lineNumber": 484
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 485
          },
          {
            "text": "                # Launch terminal for agent",
            "lineNumber": 486
          },
          {
            "text": "                terminal = self.launch_agent_terminal(agent_type)",
            "lineNumber": 487
          },
          {
            "text": "                coordination_plan[\"terminal_assignments\"][agent_type] = terminal.terminal_id",
            "lineNumber": 488
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 489
          },
          {
            "text": "        # Create conflict resolution strategy",
            "lineNumber": 490
          },
          {
            "text": "        coordination_plan[\"conflict_resolution_strategy\"] = self._create_resolution_strategy(analysis)",
            "lineNumber": 491
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 492
          },
          {
            "text": "        # Setup communication channels",
            "lineNumber": 493
          },
          {
            "text": "        coordination_plan[\"communication_channels\"] = self._setup_agent_communication()",
            "lineNumber": 494
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 495
          },
          {

        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "class MultiAgentTerminalManager:",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 226
          },
          {
            "text": "    def _broadcast_conflict(self, conflict_info: Dict[str, Any]):",
            "lineNumber": 227
          },
          {
            "text": "        \"\"\"コンフリクト情報を全エージェントにブロードキャスト\"\"\"",
            "lineNumber": 228
          },
          {
            "text": "        message = {",
            "lineNumber": 229
          },
          {
            "text": "            'type': 'conflict_alert',",
            "lineNumber": 230
          },
          {
            "text": "            'conflict': conflict_info,",
            "lineNumber": 231
          },
          {
            "text": "            'timestamp': time.time()",
            "lineNumber": 232
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 233
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 234
          },
          {
            "text": "        for agent_id, sock in self.agent_sockets.items():",
            "lineNumber": 235
          },
          {
            "text": "            try:",
            "lineNumber": 236
          },
          {
            "text": "                sock.send(json.dumps(message).encode())",
            "lineNumber": 237
          },
          {
            "text": "            except Exception as e:",
            "lineNumber": 238
          },
          {
            "text": "                logger.error(f\"Failed to send conflict alert to {agent_id}: {e}\")",
            "lineNumber": 239
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 240
          },
          {
            "text": "    def launch_agent(self, agent_role: AgentRole, task_description: str,",
            "lineNumber": 241
          },
          {
            "text": "                    working_dir: Optional[Path] = None) -&gt; Optional[str]:",
            "lineNumber": 242
          },
          {
            "text": "        \"\"\"指定された役割のエージェントを起動\"\"\"",
            "lineNumber": 243
          },
          {
            "text": "        if len(self.active_agents) &gt;= self.max_terminals:",
            "lineNumber": 244
          },
          {
            "text": "            logger.warning(\"Maximum terminal limit reached\")",
            "lineNumber": 245
          },
          {
            "text": "            return None",
            "lineNumber": 246
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 247
          },
          {
            "text": "        agent_id = f\"{agent_role.value}_{int(time.time())}\"",
            "lineNumber": 248
          },
          {
            "text": "        working_directory = working_dir or self.repo_path",
            "lineNumber": 249
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 250
          },
          {
            "text": "        # Launch terminal for agent",
            "lineNumber": 251
          },
          {
            "text": "        if self.conflict_engine:",
            "lineNumber": 252
          },
          {
            "text": "            terminal = self.conflict_engine.launch_agent_terminal(agent_id, working_directory)",
            "lineNumber": 253
          },
          {
            "text": "        else:",
            "lineNumber": 254
          },
          {
            "text": "            # Fallback terminal launch",
            "lineNumber": 255
          },
          {
            "text": "            terminal = self._launch_terminal_fallback(agent_id, working_directory)",
            "lineNumber": 256
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 257
          },
          {
            "text": "        if not terminal:",
            "lineNumber": 258
          },
          {
            "text": "            logger.error(f\"Failed to launch terminal for agent {agent_id}\")",
            "lineNumber": 259
          },
          {
            "text": "            return None",
            "lineNumber": 260
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 261
          },
          {
            "text": "        # Create agent process",
            "lineNumber": 262
          },
          {
            "text": "        agent = AgentProcess(",
            "lineNumber": 263
          },
          {
            "text": "            agent_id=agent_id,",
            "lineNumber": 264
          },
          {
            "text": "            role=agent_role,",
            "lineNumber": 265
          },
          {
            "text": "            terminal=terminal,",
            "lineNumber": 266
          },
          {
            "text": "            status=AgentStatus.IDLE,",
            "lineNumber": 267
          },
          {
            "text": "            working_directory=working_directory,",
            "lineNumber": 268
          },
          {
            "text": "            assigned_task=task_description,",
            "lineNumber": 269
          },
          {
            "text": "            start_time=time.time(),",
            "lineNumber": 270
          },
          {
            "text": "            end_time=None,",
            "lineNumber": 271
          },
          {
            "text": "            results={}",
            "lineNumber": 272
          },
          {
            "text": "        )",
            "lineNumber": 273
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 274
          },
          {
            "text": "        self.active_agents[agent_id] = agent",
            "lineNumber": 275
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 276
          },
          {
            "text": "        # Send initial task to agent",
            "lineNumber": 277
          },
          {
            "text": "        self._send_task_to_agent(agent_id, task_description)",
            "lineNumber": 278
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 279
          },
          {
            "text": "        logger.info(f\"Launched agent {agent_id} with role {agent_role.value}\")",
            "lineNumber": 280
          },
          {
            "text": "        return agent_id",
            "lineNumber": 281
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 282
          },
          {
            "text": "    def _launch_terminal_fallback(self, agent_id: str, working_dir: Path) -&gt; Optional[AgentTerminal]:",
            "lineNumber": 283
          },
          {
            "text": "        ",

          }

          {
            "text": "    def _handle_conflict_detection(self, agent_id: str, message: Dict[str, Any]):",
            "lineNumber": 191
          },
          {
            "text": "        \"\"\"コンフリクト検知を処理\"\"\"",
            "lineNumber": 192
          },
          {
            "text": "        conflict_info = message.get('conflict', {})",
            "lineNumber": 193
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 194
          },
          {
            "text": "        logger.warning(f\"Conflict detected by agent {agent_id}: {conflict_info}\")",
            "lineNumber": 195
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 196
          },
          {
            "text": "        # Notify other agents about the conflict",

          },

            "text": "        self._broadcast_conflict(conflict_info)",
            "lineNumber": 198
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 199
          },
          {
            "text": "        # Launch conflict resolution agent if needed",
            "lineNumber": 200
          },
          {
            "text": "        if conflict_info.get('severity', 'low') in ['high', 'critical']:",
            "lineNumber": 201
          },
          {
            "text": "            self.launch_conflict_resolution_agent(conflict_info)",
            "lineNumber": 202
          },

          },

          },
          {

          },

            "lineNumber": 19
          },

          },

          },
          {

          },

    {
      "codeBlock": {

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "    # Ensure worktrees directory exists",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (!(Test-Path $WorktreeRoot)) {",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $WorktreeRoot | Out-Null",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "    $worktreePath = Join-Path $WorktreeRoot $BranchName",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "    # Check if worktree already exists",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (Test-Path $worktreePath) {",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "        Write-Warning \"Worktree already exists at: $worktreePath\"",
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "        if ($Force) {",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "text": "            Write-Host \"Force removing existing worktree...\"",
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "            git worktree remove $worktreePath --force 2&gt;$null",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "text": "            Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $worktreePath 2&gt;$null",
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "        } else {",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "            return",
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "text": "    try {",
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "        # Create worktree",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "text": "        git worktree add $worktreePath $Base",
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "text": "        # Create and checkout branch if different from base",
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "text": "        if ($BranchName -ne $Base) {",
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "            Push-Location $worktreePath",
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "text": "            try {",
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "                git checkout -b $BranchName",
            "lineNumber": 96
          },
          {
            "text": "            } finally {",
            "lineNumber": 97
          },
          {
            "text": "                Pop-Location",
            "lineNumber": 98
          },
          {
            "text": "            }",
            "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 100
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {
            "text": "        Write-Host \"✅ Worktree created successfully: $worktreePath\" -ForegroundColor Green",
            "lineNumber": 102
          },
          {
            "text": "        Write-Host \"📁 Branch: $BranchName\" -ForegroundColor Yellow",
            "lineNumber": 103
          },
          {
            "text": "        Write-Host \"🔗 Base: $Base\" -ForegroundColor Yellow",
            "lineNumber": 104
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 105
          },
          {
            "text": "        return $worktreePath",
            "lineNumber": 106
          },
          {
            "text": "    } catch {",
            "lineNumber": 107
          },
          {
            "text": "        Write-Error \"Failed to create worktree: $_\"",
            "lineNumber": 108
          },
          {
            "text": "        return $null",
            "lineNumber": 109
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 110
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 111
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 112
          },
          {
            "text": "function Remove-Worktree {",
            "lineNumber": 113
          },
          {
            "text": "    param([string]$BranchName)",
            "lineNumber": 114
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 115
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (!$BranchName) {",
            "lineNumber": 116
          },
          {
            "text": "        Write-Error \"Branch name is required for 'remove' action\"",
            "lineNumber": 117
          },
          {
            "text": "        return",
            "lineNumber": 118
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 119
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 120
          },
          {
            "text": "    $worktreePath = Join-Path $WorktreeRoot $BranchName",
            "lineNumber": 121
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 122
          },
          {
            "text": "    if (!(Test-Path $worktreePath)) {",
            "lineNumber": 123
          },
          {
            "text": "        Write-Warning \"Worktree does not exist: $worktreePath\"",
            "lineNumber": 124
          },
          {
            "text": "        return",
            "lineNumber": 125
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 126
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 127
          },
          {
            "text": "    Write-Header \"Removing worktree: $BranchName\"",
            "lineNumber": 128
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 129
          },
          {
            "text": "    try {",
            "lineNumber": 130
          },
          {
            "text": "        # Remove worktree",
            "lineNumber": 131
          },
          {
            "text": "        git worktree remove $worktreePath 2&gt;$null",
            "lineNumber": 132
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 133
          },
          {
            "text": "        # Clean up directory if it still exists",
            "lineNumber": 134
          }
        ]
