        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "class WorktreeManager:",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 237
          },
          {
            "text": "    def create_worktree(self, name: str, branch: str, worktree_type: WorktreeType,",
            "lineNumber": 238
          },
          {
            "text": "                       description: str = \"\", base_branch: str = \"main\") -&gt; Optional[WorktreeInfo]:",

          },
          {
            "text": "        \"\"\"Create a new git worktree\"\"\"",
            "lineNumber": 240
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 241
          },
          {
            "text": "        # Check limits",
            "lineNumber": 242
          },
          {
            "text": "        active_count = sum(1 for wt in self.worktrees.values()",
            "lineNumber": 243
          },
          {
            "text": "                          if wt.status in [WorktreeStatus.ACTIVE, WorktreeStatus.CREATING])",
            "lineNumber": 244
          },
          {
            "text": "        if active_count &gt;= self.config.max_concurrent:",
            "lineNumber": 245
          },
          {
            "text": "            logger.error(f\"Maximum concurrent worktrees ({self.config.max_concurrent}) reached\")",
            "lineNumber": 246
          },
          {
            "text": "            return None",
            "lineNumber": 247
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 248
          },
          {
            "text": "        # Check if worktree already exists",
            "lineNumber": 249
          },
          {
            "text": "        if name in self.worktrees:",
            "lineNumber": 250
          },
          {
            "text": "            logger.error(f\"Worktree '{name}' already exists\")",
            "lineNumber": 251
          },
          {
            "text": "            return None",
            "lineNumber": 252
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 253
          },
          {
            "text": "        try:",
            "lineNumber": 254
          },
          {
            "text": "            # Get current commit hash from base branch",
            "lineNumber": 255
          },
          {
            "text": "            result = subprocess.run(",
            "lineNumber": 256
          },
          {
            "text": "                [\"git\", \"rev-parse\", f\"origin/{base_branch}\"],",
            "lineNumber": 257
          },
          {
            "text": "                capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=self.config.base_path,",
            "lineNumber": 258
          },
          {
            "text": "                timeout=30",
            "lineNumber": 259
          },
          {
            "text": "            )",
            "lineNumber": 260
          },
          {
            "text": "            if result.returncode != 0:",
            "lineNumber": 261
          },
          {
            "text": "                logger.error(f\"Failed to get commit hash: {result.stderr}\")",
            "lineNumber": 262
          },
          {
            "text": "                return None",
            "lineNumber": 263
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 264
          },
          {
            "text": "            parent_commit = result.stdout.strip()",
            "lineNumber": 265
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 266
          },
          {
            "text": "            # Create worktree path",
            "lineNumber": 267
          },
          {
            "text": "            worktree_path = self.config.base_path / name",
            "lineNumber": 268
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 269
          },
          {
            "text": "            # Create git worktree",
            "lineNumber": 270
          },
          {
            "text": "            logger.info(f\"Creating worktree '{name}' at {worktree_path}\")",
            "lineNumber": 271
          },
          {
            "text": "            result = subprocess.run(",
            "lineNumber": 272
          },
          {
            "text": "                [\"git\", \"worktree\", \"add\", \"-b\", branch, str(worktree_path)],",
            "lineNumber": 273
          },
          {
            "text": "                capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=self.config.base_path,",
            "lineNumber": 274
          },
          {
            "text": "                timeout=60",
            "lineNumber": 275
          },
          {
            "text": "            )",
            "lineNumber": 276
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 277
          },
          {
            "text": "            if result.returncode != 0:",
            "lineNumber": 278
          },
          {
            "text": "                logger.error(f\"Failed to create worktree: {result.stderr}\")",
            "lineNumber": 279
          },
          {
            "text": "                return None",
            "lineNumber": 280
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 281
          },
          {
            "text": "            # Create worktree info",
            "lineNumber": 282
          },
          {
            "text": "            now = datetime.now()",
            "lineNumber": 283
          },
          {
            "text": "            worktree_info = WorktreeInfo(",
            "lineNumber": 284
          },
          {
            "text": "                name=name,",
            "lineNumber": 285
          },
          {
            "text": "                branch=branch,",
            "lineNumber": 286
          },
          {
            "text": "                path=worktree_path",

            "text": "class GitWorktreeManager:",

            "text": "def create_worktree(self, name: str, branch: str, worktree_type: WorktreeType,",

          },
          {
            "text": "                       description: str = \"\", base_branch: str = \"main\") -&gt; Optional[WorktreeInfo]:",

            "lineNumber": 129
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 130
          },
          {
            "text": "        try:",

          },

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 135
          },

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 138
          },

            "lineNumber": 139
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 140
          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 142
          },
          {
            "text": "            # Create worktree path",
            "lineNumber": 143
          },
          {
            "text": "            worktree_path = self.config.base_path / name",
            "lineNumber": 144
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 145
          },
          {
            "text": "            # Create git worktree",
            "lineNumber": 146
          },
          {
            "text": "            logger.info(f\"Creating worktree '{name}' at {worktree_path}\")",
            "lineNumber": 147
          },
          {
            "text": "            result = subprocess.run(",

          },
          {
            "text": "                [\"git\", \"worktree\", \"add\", \"-b\", branch, str(worktree_path)],",
            "lineNumber": 149
          },
          {
            "text": "                capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=self.config.base_path",
            "lineNumber": 150
          },
          {
            "text": "            )",
            "lineNumber": 151
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 152
          },
          {
            "text": "            if result.returncode != 0:",
            "lineNumber": 153
          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 156
          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
          {

          {

          {

          },
          {
            "text": "                parent_commit=parent_commit",
            "lineNumber": 168
          },
          {
            "text": "            )",
            "lineNumber": 169
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 170
          },
          {
            "text": "            self.worktrees[name] = worktree_info",
            "lineNumber": 171
          },
          {
            "text": "            self.save_worktrees()",

          },

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "            return worktree_info",

          },

            "lineNumber": 176
          },

          },

            "text": "impl WorktreeManager {",

          {
            "text": "    /// Create a new worktree manager",

          },
          {
            "text": "    pub fn new(repo_root: PathBuf, worktree_base: PathBuf) -&gt; Result&lt;Self&gt; {",

          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Create a worktree for a variant",
            "lineNumber": 163
          },
          {
            "text": "    pub fn create_worktree(&amp;self, variant_name: &amp;str) -&gt; Result&lt;PathBuf&gt; {",

          },
          {
            "text": "        let branch_name = format!(\"plan-competition-{variant_name}\");",

          },
          {
            "text": "        let worktree_path = self.worktree_base.join(variant_name);",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 167
          },
          {
            "text": "        // Remove existing worktree if present",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 170
          },
          {
            "text": "        // Create new branch",

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 172
          },
          {
            "text": "            .current_dir(&amp;self.repo_root)",

          },
          {
            "text": "            .args([\"branch\", &amp;branch_name])",
            "lineNumber": 174
          },
          {
            "text": "            .output()",
            "lineNumber": 175
          },
          {
            "text": "            .context(\"Failed to create branch\")?;",
            "lineNumber": 176
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 177
          },
          {
            "text": "        if !output.status.success() {",
            "lineNumber": 178
          },
          {
            "text": "            // Branch might already exist, that's ok",
            "lineNumber": 179
          },
          {
            "text": "            debug!(\"Branch {} might already exist\", branch_name);",
            "lineNumber": 180
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 181
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 182
          },
          {
            "text": "        // Create worktree",
            "lineNumber": 183
          },
          {
            "text": "        let output = Command::new(\"git\")",
            "lineNumber": 184
          },
          {
            "text": "            .current_dir(&amp;self.repo_root)",
            "lineNumber": 185
          },
          {
            "text": "            .args([",
            "lineNumber": 186
          },
          {
            "text": "                \"worktree\",",
            "lineNumber": 187
          },
          {
            "text": "                \"add\",",
            "lineNumber": 188
          },
          {
            "text": "                worktree_path.to_str().unwrap(),",
            "lineNumber": 189
          },
          {
            "text": "                &amp;branch_name,",
            "lineNumber": 190
          },
          {
            "text": "            ])",
            "lineNumber": 191
          },
          {
            "text": "            .output()",
            "lineNumber": 192
          },
          {
            "text": "            .context(\"Failed to create worktree\")?;",
            "lineNumber": 193
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 194
          },
          {
            "text": "        if !output.status.success() {",
            "lineNumber": 195
          },
          {
            "text": "            let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&amp;output.stderr);",
            "lineNumber": 196
          },
          {
            "text": "            anyhow::bail!(\"Failed to create worktree: {stderr}\");",
            "lineNumber": 197
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 198
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 199
          },
          {
            "text": "        info!(",
            "lineNumber": 200
          },
          {
            "text": "            \"Created worktree for variant {}: {:?}\",",
            "lineNumber": 201
          },
          {
            "text": "            variant_name, worktree_path",
            "lineNumber": 202
          },
          {
            "text": "        );",
            "lineNumber": 203
          },
          {
            "text": "        Ok(worktree_path)",

            "lineNumber": 205
          },

          },

          },

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 209
          },
          {
            "text": "            return Ok(());",
            "lineNumber": 210
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 211

        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Worktree Manager Agent Skill",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## Overview",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "Advanced Git worktree management agent that orchestrates parallel development environments with integrated quality assurance and automated workflow management. Enables concurrent feature development, isolated testing environments, and seamless integration with CI/CD pipelines.",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "## Capabilities",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Parallel Development**: Create and manage multiple isolated worktrees for concurrent development",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Environment Isolation**: Complete separation of development branches and workspaces",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Quality Integration**: Automatic QA execution per worktree with status tracking",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Terminal Management**: Automated terminal launching and process management",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Workflow Automation**: Git operations, merging, and conflict resolution",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Resource Management**: Worktree lifecycle management and cleanup automation",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "## Tools Required",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "### MCP Tools",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex_read_file&#96; - Reading worktree configurations and status files",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex_write_file&#96; - Generating worktree metadata and reports",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex_codebase_search&#96; - Analyzing project structure across worktrees",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;grep&#96; - Searching for worktree-related files and patterns",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;read_file&#96; - File access for worktree operations",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;write&#96; - Creating worktree artifacts and logs",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "### File System Access",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Read**: Full repository access for worktree management",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Write**: Limited to &#96;./worktrees&#96;, &#96;./.worktrees.json&#96;, &#96;./worktree-artifacts&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "### Network Access",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "- **None required** - Local Git operations only",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "### Shell Commands",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;git worktree&#96; - Git worktree operations (add, remove, list, prune)",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;git checkout&#96; - Branch switching and creation",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;git merge&#96; - Worktree merging operations",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;git status&#96; - Worktree status checking",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;git log&#96; - Worktree history analysis",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;ps&#96; - Process management for terminal instances",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "## Usage Examples",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "### Create Parallel Development Environment",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "codex $worktree-manager \"Create parallel development environment for user authentication feature\"",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "### Manage Feature Branches",

        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "class WorktreeManager:",

            "isSignature": true

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 237
          },
          {
            "text": "    def create_worktree(self, name: str, branch: str, worktree_type: WorktreeType,",
            "lineNumber": 238
          },
          {
            "text": "                       description: str = \"\", base_branch: str = \"main\") -&gt; Optional[WorktreeInfo]:",
            "lineNumber": 239
          },
          {
            "text": "        \"\"\"Create a new git worktree\"\"\"",
            "lineNumber": 240
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 241
          },
          {
            "text": "        # Check limits",
            "lineNumber": 242
          },
          {
            "text": "        active_count = sum(1 for wt in self.worktrees.values()",
            "lineNumber": 243
          },
          {
            "text": "                          if wt.status in [WorktreeStatus.ACTIVE, WorktreeStatus.CREATING])",
            "lineNumber": 244
          },
          {
            "text": "        if active_count &gt;= self.config.max_concurrent:",
            "lineNumber": 245
          },
          {
            "text": "            logger.error(f\"Maximum concurrent worktrees ({self.config.max_concurrent}) reached\")",
            "lineNumber": 246
          },
          {
            "text": "            return None",
            "lineNumber": 247
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 248
          },
          {
            "text": "        # Check if worktree already exists",
            "lineNumber": 249
          },
          {
            "text": "        if name in self.worktrees:",
            "lineNumber": 250
          },

diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
index e69de29bb..e59606957 100644
--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -0,0 +1,162 @@
+# Codex (zapabob fork) — AI-Native Development Platform
+
+**For AI tech recruiters (Sakana AI, AMD, etc.)**: This repo demonstrates **production-grade multi-agent orchestration** with unique innovations in conflict prevention, quality competition, and parallel development workflows.
+
+**AIテック企業採用担当者向け**: 本リポジトリは、**コンフリクト予防、品質競争、並列開発ワークフロー**における独自のイノベーションを含む、**プロダクショングレードのマルチエージェントオーケストレーション**を実装しています。
+
+---
+
+## 🎯 Unique Differentiators（独自性）
+
+### 1. **Plan Mode with Approval Gates** / 承認ゲート付きPlan Mode
+
+**What it is**: 3-phase workflow (Planning → Approval → Execution) with **zero side effects** until human approval.
+
+**独自性**: 計画段階は副作用なし、承認後にのみ実行。運用前提のガードレール設計。
+
+- **Implementation**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/plan/&#96; - Budget management, execution logging, audit trail
+- **Quickstart**: &#96;docs/plan/README.md&#96; (5-minute reproducible guide)
+
+---
+
+### 2. **Deep Research Engine** / Deep Researchエンジン
+
+**What it is**: Multi-source research with citation management, contradiction detection, and 15+ MCP server integration.
+
+**独自性**: 引用管理と矛盾検出機能を持つマルチソースリサーチエンジン。15以上のMCPサーバーを統合。
+
+- **Implementation**: &#96;codex-rs/deep-research/&#96; - Multi-source validation, evidence synthesis
+- **Features**: Citation tracking, source validation, intelligent caching
+- **Usage**: &#96;codex research "React Server Components best practices" --depth 3&#96;
+
+---
+
+### 3. **Parallel Sub-Agents with Specialization** / 専門化された並列サブエージェント
+
+**What it is**: Specialized AI agents (Backend/Frontend/Database/Security/QA) execute in parallel with conflict resolution.
+
+**独自性**: 専門AIエージェント（Backend/Frontend/Database/Security/QA）が並列実行され、コンフリクト解決を内蔵。
+
+- **Implementation**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/agents/&#96; - AgentRuntime, parallel executor, conflict resolver
+- **Agents**: 8+ predefined agents + custom YAML-defined agents
+- **Usage**: &#96;codex delegate-parallel backend-agent,frontend-agent,database-agent --scopes ./src/backend,./src/frontend,./src/database&#96;
+
+---
+
+### 4. **QC Agent with Quantum &amp; Mathematical Optimization** / 量子・数理最適化を備えたQCエージェント
+
+**What it is**: Quality Control agent using **statistical analysis**, **quantum optimization (QAOA, VQE)**, and **mathematical optimization (linear programming, convex optimization)** to compute quality scores.
+
+**独自性**: 統計分析、量子最適化（QAOA、VQE）、数理最適化（線形計画法、凸最適化）による品質スコア計算。
+
+- **Implementation**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/qc/&#96; - QcAgent, quantum.rs, mathematical.rs
+- **Metrics**: Readability, maintainability, performance, security (weighted scoring)
+- **Integration**: Used in competition mode for winner selection
+
+---
+
+### 5. **A2A Communication for Conflict Prevention** / コンフリクト予防のためのA2A通信
+
+**What it is**: Agent-to-Agent communication system that **predicts file overlaps** and **broadcasts conflict summaries** before execution, preventing merge conflicts proactively.
+
+**独自性**: 実行前にファイル重複を予測し、コンフリクト要約をブロードキャストすることで、マージコンフリクトを事前に防止。
+
+- **Implementation**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/a2a_communication.rs&#96; - A2ACommunicationManager, trust management, coordination
+- **Conflict Prevention**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/orchestration/conflict_prevention.rs&#96; - File overlap prediction, A2A signal broadcasting
+- **Features**: Role-based messaging, shared state management, fault tolerance
+
+---
+
+### 6. **Git Worktree-Based Parallel Development** / Git Worktreeベースの並列開発
+
+**What it is**: Each AI agent gets an **isolated Git worktree** to work independently, eliminating merge conflicts through physical isolation.
+
+**独自性**: 各AIエージェントが独立したGit worktreeを取得し、物理的な分離によりマージコンフリクトを排除。
+
+- **Implementation**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/orchestration/worktree_manager.rs&#96; - WorktreeManager, branch isolation
+- **Usage**: Competition mode automatically creates worktrees per agent variant
+- **Benefits**: Zero merge conflicts, parallel development, easy cleanup
+
+---
+
+### 7. **QC Competition Mode** / QCコンペティションモード
+
+**What it is**: Multiple agents compete on the same task in isolated worktrees. **QC Agent evaluates each variant** using quantum + mathematical optimization, then **automatically merges the highest-quality implementation**.
+
+**独自性**: 複数のエージェントが分離されたworktreeで同じタスクに競合。QCエージェントが量子・数理最適化で各バリアントを評価し、**最高品質の実装を自動マージ**。
+
+- **Implementation**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/orchestration/integrated_competition.rs&#96; - IntegratedCompetitionRunner
+- **Scoring**: QC overall score + QC optimization bonus (from quantum/mathematical metrics)
+- **Workflow**: Create worktrees → Parallel execution → QC analysis → Winner selection → Auto-merge
+- **Logging**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/orchestration/qc_logger.rs&#96; - Detailed QC analysis logs
+
+---
+
+### 8. **GUI + 3D/4D Visualization Surface** / GUI + 3D/4D可視化（“画面で見せられる”）
+
+**What it is**: A web UI layer to **create/approve/monitor Plans**, observe agent activity, and **visualize repositories** (3D/4D, WebXR-ready components exist in the codebase).
+
+**独自性**: CLIだけで終わらず、**Plan運用（承認/実行/監視）をGUIで扱える**＋**Git可視化（3D/4D）**まで“見せる面”を持っている。
+
+- **Main GUI (Next.js)**: &#96;gui/&#96; (dashboard, plan management, visualization, XR utilities)
+  - Docs: &#96;gui/README.md&#96;
+- **Repo visualizer (Rust + React + Three.js)**: &#96;extensions/codex-viz-web/&#96;
+  - Docs: &#96;extensions/codex-viz-web/README.md&#96;
+- **Prism web app**: &#96;prism-web/&#96; (separate product surface + MCP integration described there)
+  - Docs: &#96;prism-web/README.md&#96;
+- **E2E**: &#96;gui-tests/&#96; (Playwright reports/tests live here)
+
+---
+

## 起動時にPythonが勝手に起動するの、止めたで

- **`.cursor/settings.json`**: Python系を**全面無効化**（analysis / language server / lint / format）
- **`.cursor/extensions.json`**: Python拡張（`ms-python.python`, `ms-python.vscode-pylance`）を**推奨から削除**
- **実装ログ**: `_docs/2026-01-29_ポートフォリオ導線整理{main}.md` に追記済み

これでワークスペースを開いた瞬間にPython（Pylance/Pylint等）がバックグラウンド起動する挙動は止まるはずや。

---

SO8Tの「電源投入時Python自動再開」、**止め切ったで**（タスクが残っててもPythonが走らんように“起動側”にキルスイッチ入れた）。

### いま起動時に走る原因（SO8T側で確認できたやつ）
- **Task Scheduler（ONLOGON）** を作るバッチが複数ある  
  - `scripts/startup/setup_task_scheduler.bat`（`SO8T_Power_On_Startup`）
  - `scripts/startup/setup_advanced_science_task_scheduler.bat`（`Advanced_Science_Pipeline_Power_On`）
  - `scripts/startup/setup_aegis_task.bat`（`SO8T_AEGIS_Automatic_Pipeline`）
  - `automation/setup_ab_test_automation.bat`（`AEGIS_AB_Test_Automation` / `AEGIS_AB_Test_Daily` + Startupショートカット）
  - `scripts/utils/setup_auto_resume_task.bat`（`SO8T_GGUF_AB_Test_Auto_Resume`）
  - `scripts/utils/setup_gguf_conversion_auto_resume.bat`（`GGUF_Conversion_Auto_Resume`）

### 対応（“再開機能等を停止”）
- **起動側バッチにキルスイッチ追加**（タスクが残ってても即終了＝Python起動しない）
  - `scripts/startup/so8t_power_on_startup.bat`
  - `scripts/startup/advanced_science_pipeline_startup.bat`
  - どっちも **`SO8T_ENABLE_AUTOSTART=1` が無いと exit** する仕様に変更
- **タスク作成系バッチもデフォルト無効化**（将来勝手に再登録されない）
  - 上で列挙した setup 系 `.bat` 全てに **`SO8T_ENABLE_AUTOSTART=1` の明示が無いと exit** のガード追加
- **スタートアップフォルダのショートカット（AEGIS系）削除**は実行済み

### まだ残ってるScheduled Taskについて（重要）
こちらの環境だと **管理者権限が必要**で、`SO8T_Power_On_Startup` / `SO8T_AEGIS_Automatic_Pipeline` の削除/無効化がこちらからは完遂できんかった。  
ただし **起動バッチ自体が即exitする**ようにしてあるから、タスクが残っててもPythonは走らん。

### 管理者で“完全にタスクも消す”用（SO8Tに追加済み）
- `scripts/startup/disable_autostart_tasks.ps1`
- 実行（管理者PowerShell）:

```powershell
cd C:\Users\downl\Desktop\SO8T
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\startup\disable_autostart_tasks.ps1 -RemoveStartupShortcuts
```

### 実装ログ
- `SO8T/_docs/2026-01-29_自動再開停止{main}.md` を追加して手順を残したで。

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\scripts\\organize_repository.py",
        "range": {

        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "#!/usr/bin/env python3",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "\"\"\"",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "リポジトリ整理スクリプト - テック企業採用担当者目線での整理",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "\"\"\"",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "import os",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "import shutil",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "import glob",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "from pathlib import Path",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "from typing import List, Set",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "import json",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "class RepositoryOrganizer:",
            "lineNumber": 13,
            "isSignature": true
          },
          {
            "text": "    def __init__(self, root_dir: str):",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "        self.root_dir = Path(root_dir)",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "        self.docs_dir = self.root_dir / \"docs\"",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "        self.tools_dir = self.root_dir / \"tools\"",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "        self.scripts_dir = self.root_dir / \"scripts\"",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "    def analyze_current_state(self):",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "        \"\"\"現在のリポジトリ状態を分析\"\"\"",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "        print(\"[ANALYSIS] Analyzing repository structure...\")",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "        # 主要ディレクトリの確認",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "        directories = [",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "            \"codex-rs\", \"codex-cli\", \"gui\", \"extensions\", \"docs\",",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "            \"_docs\", \".archive\", \"archive\", \"scripts\", \"tools\",",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "            \".codex\", \".cursor\", \".specstory\", \".serena\"",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "        ]",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "        for dir_name in directories:",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "            dir_path = self.root_dir / dir_name",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "            if dir_path.exists():",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "                file_count = len(list(dir_path.rglob(\"*\"))) if dir_path.is_dir() else 1",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "                print(f\"[DIR] {dir_name}: {file_count} files\")",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "        # 不要ファイルのチェック",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "        unwanted_patterns = [",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "            \"*.exe\", \"*.tgz\", \"*.tar.gz\", \"*build*\", \"*temp*\", \"*cache*\",",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "            \".DS_Store\", \"Thumbs.db\", \"*.log\", \"*.tmp\"",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "        ]",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "        unwanted_files = []",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "        for pattern in unwanted_patterns:",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "            unwanted_files.extend(glob.glob(str(self.root_dir / pattern), recursive=True))",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "        print(f\"[CLEANUP] Unwanted file candidates: {len(unwanted_files)} files\")",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "        for file in unwanted_files[:10]:  # 最初の10個のみ表示",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "            print(f\"  - {Path(file).relative_to(self.root_dir)}\")",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "    def create_clean_structure(self):",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "        \"\"\"クリーンなプロジェクト構造を作成\"\"\"",
            "lineNumber": 52
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.4859367609024048
    },

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\extensions\\vscode-codex\\README.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 52
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Codex AI Assistant for VSCode/Cursor",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "**Version**: 0.57.0  ",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "**Author**: zapabob  ",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "**License**: Apache-2.0  ",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "**Published**: 2025-11-02",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "## Overview",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "Autonomous AI coding assistant with sub-agent orchestration and deep research capabilities, integrated directly into VSCode and Cursor IDE. This extension provides seamless access to the Codex Orchestrator RPC server, enabling task delegation, code review, deep research, and real-time agent monitoring from within your editor.",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "## Features",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "### 🎯 Orchestrator Integration",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Auto-start Orchestrator**: Automatically starts the Codex Orchestrator RPC server",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Status Monitoring**: Real-time monitoring of orchestrator status, agents, and tasks",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Transport Options**: Support for TCP, Unix Domain Socket, and Named Pipe",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "### 🤖 Sub-Agent Delegation",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Code Reviewer**: Review code for security, performance, and best practices",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Test Generator**: Automatically generate unit and integration tests",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Security Auditor**: Scan for vulnerabilities and security issues",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Refactorer**: Suggest and apply code refactorings",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Architect**: Design and plan system architecture",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "### 🔍 Deep Research",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Multi-source Research**: Search and analyze multiple sources",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Citation-based Reporting**: Get research results with proper citations",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Gemini Integration**: Leverage Google Gemini for enhanced research",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "### 📊 Visual Interface",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Orchestrator Status View**: Monitor orchestrator health and performance",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Active Agents View**: See all running agents and their status",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Research History View**: Browse past research queries and results",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "- **MCP Servers View**: Manage MCP server connections",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "### ⌨️ Keyboard Shortcuts",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;Ctrl+Shift+D&#96;: Delegate task to agent",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;Ctrl+Shift+R&#96;: Start deep research",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;Ctrl+Shift+C&#96;: Review selected code",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "## Installation",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "### Prerequisites",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "1. Install Codex CLI:",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "cargo install --path codex-rs/cli --force",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "2. Verify installation:",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 52
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.42145663499832153
    },
    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\README.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 40
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Codex (zapabob fork) — AI-Native Development Platform",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "**For AI tech recruiters (Sakana AI, AMD, etc.)**: This repo demonstrates **production-grade multi-agent orchestration** with unique innovations in conflict prevention, quality competition, and parallel development workflows.",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "**AIテック企業採用担当者向け**: 本リポジトリは、**コンフリクト予防、品質競争、並列開発ワークフロー**における独自のイノベーションを含む、**プロダクショングレードのマルチエージェントオーケストレーション**を実装しています。",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🎯 Unique Differentiators（独自性）",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. **Plan Mode with Approval Gates** / 承認ゲート付きPlan Mode",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "**What it is**: 3-phase workflow (Planning → Approval → Execution) with **zero side effects** until human approval.",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "**独自性**: 計画段階は副作用なし、承認後にのみ実行。運用前提のガードレール設計。",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Implementation**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/plan/&#96; - Budget management, execution logging, audit trail",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Quickstart**: &#96;docs/plan/README.md&#96; (5-minute reproducible guide)",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. **Deep Research Engine** / Deep Researchエンジン",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "**What it is**: Multi-source research with citation management, contradiction detection, and 15+ MCP server integration.",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "**独自性**: 引用管理と矛盾検出機能を持つマルチソースリサーチエンジン。15以上のMCPサーバーを統合。",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Implementation**: &#96;codex-rs/deep-research/&#96; - Multi-source validation, evidence synthesis",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Features**: Citation tracking, source validation, intelligent caching",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Usage**: &#96;codex research \"React Server Components best practices\" --depth 3&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "### 3. **Parallel Sub-Agents with Specialization** / 専門化された並列サブエージェント",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "**What it is**: Specialized AI agents (Backend/Frontend/Database/Security/QA) execute in parallel with conflict resolution.",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "**独自性**: 専門AIエージェント（Backend/Frontend/Database/Security/QA）が並列実行され、コンフリクト解決を内蔵。",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Implementation**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/agents/&#96; - AgentRuntime, parallel executor, conflict resolver",
            "lineNumber": 40
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.41997531056404114
    },

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Codex Supervisor",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "**Official OpenAI Codex Agents SDK Supervisor** - MCP-Centric Multi-Agent Workflow Orchestrator",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "This is an independent package that provides advanced multi-agent orchestration capabilities for OpenAI Codex, implementing the official Agents SDK patterns including handoffs, guardrails, and worker agents.",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "## Overview",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "Codex Supervisor extends OpenAI Codex with sophisticated multi-agent workflows while maintaining compatibility with the official Skills + MCP + Agents SDK architecture. It acts as an intelligent coordinator that delegates complex tasks to specialized Codex Skills via MCP.",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "## Architecture",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "┌─────────────────┐    ┌──────────────────┐",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "│   Supervisor    │────│   Codex MCP      │",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "│   Orchestrator  │    │   Server         │",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "│ (This Package)  │    └──────────────────┘",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "└─────────────────┘             │",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "         │                      │",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "         ├──────────────────────┤",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "         │                      │",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "    ┌────▼────┐    ┌─────────────┐",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "    │  Skill  │    │   Skill     │",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "    │ Worker A│    │  Worker B   │",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "    └─────────┘    └─────────────┘",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "## Official Agents SDK Compliance",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "This supervisor implements all official OpenAI Agents SDK concepts:",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "### 🔒 Guardrails",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Security Guardrail**: Prevents dangerous operations and validates inputs",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Quality Guardrail**: Ensures code quality and testing requirements",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Custom Guardrails**: Extensible guardrail system for domain-specific rules",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "### 🤝 Handoffs",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Task Handoffs**: Seamless task transitions between worker agents",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Conditional Handoffs**: Context-aware task delegation",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Handoff Tracking**: Complete audit trail of task transitions",
            "lineNumber": 40
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.40210509300231934
    },

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# 🚀 Codex - AI-Powered Multi-Agent Coding Assistant",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "&lt;div align=\"center\"&gt;",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-0.47.0--alpha.1-blue.svg)](https://github.com/zapabob/codex)",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "[![Rust](https://img.shields.io/badge/rust-1.76%2B-orange.svg)](https://www.rust-lang.org)",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache--2.0-green.svg)](LICENSE)",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "[![Build Status](https://img.shields.io/badge/build-passing-brightgreen.svg)](https://github.com/zapabob/codex)",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "**AIコーディングアシスタントの決定版 - 自律オーケストレーション・Deep Research・MCP統合**",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "[English](#english) | [日本語](#japanese)",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "&lt;/div&gt;",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "&lt;a name=\"english\"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📖 English Documentation",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "### 🎯 What is Codex?",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "**Codex** is a next-generation AI coding assistant that combines the power of **specialized sub-agents**, **autonomous orchestration**, and **deep research** capabilities. Built on a high-performance Rust core with seamless integration across multiple IDEs, Codex revolutionizes how developers write, test, and deploy code.",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "### ✨ Key Features",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "| Feature | Description |",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "|---------|-------------|",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "| **🤖 Auto-Orchestration** | Automatically analyzes task complexity and coordinates specialized sub-agents in parallel |",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "| **⚡ 2.6x Faster** | Parallel execution of independent tasks for maximum productivity |",
            "lineNumber": 30

          },

            "lineNumber": 36

            "text": "- [クイックスタート](#クイックスタート)",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "- [コマンド例](#コマンド例)",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "- [アーキテクチャ](#アーキテクチャ)",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "- [API統合](#api統合)",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "- [開発](#開発)",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "- [トラブルシューティング](#トラブルシューティング)",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🎯 概要",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "Codex Deep Researchは、**OpenAI/codexのWeb検索機能**と**DuckDuckGo HTMLスクレイピング**を統合した高度な調査ツールです。",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "### ✨ 主な特徴",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "- 🔓 **APIキー不要**: DuckDuckGoによりゼロコストで即座に利用可能",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "- 🤖 **Gemini CLI統合**: Google Search + Gemini AIによる高品質検索 🆕",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "- 🔄 **3段階フォールバック**: 商用API → DuckDuckGo → 公式フォーマット",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "- 🌐 **複数バックエンド対応**: Gemini CLI, Brave, Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "- 🎯 **計画的調査**: サブクエリ分解 → 多段探索 → 矛盾検出",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "- 📊 **引用必須レポート**: Markdown形式で完全な引用付きレポート生成",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🚀 主な機能",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. Web検索プロバイダー",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "#### DuckDuckGo（デフォルト・APIキー不要）",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "use codex_deep_research::WebSearchProvider;",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "let provider = WebSearchProvider::default();",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "let results = provider.duckduckgo_search_real(\"Rust async programming\", 5).await?;",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "**特徴**:",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ 完全無料（APIキー不要）",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ 即座に利用可能",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ プライバシー保護",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "- ⚡ 応答速度: 1-3秒",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 商用API（オプション）",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "# Brave Search API（推奨）",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "export BRAVE_API_KEY=\"your-api-key\"",
            "lineNumber": 60
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.5796398520469666
    },

            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🎯 概要",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "Codex Deep Researchは、**OpenAI/codexのWeb検索機能**と**DuckDuckGo HTMLスクレイピング**を統合した高度な調査ツールです。",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "### ✨ 主な特徴",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "- 🔓 **APIキー不要**: DuckDuckGoによりゼロコストで即座に利用可能",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "- 🤖 **Gemini CLI統合**: Google Search + Gemini AIによる高品質検索 🆕",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "- 🔄 **3段階フォールバック**: 商用API → DuckDuckGo → 公式フォーマット",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "- 🌐 **複数バックエンド対応**: Gemini CLI, Brave, Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "- 🎯 **計画的調査**: サブクエリ分解 → 多段探索 → 矛盾検出",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "- 📊 **引用必須レポート**: Markdown形式で完全な引用付きレポート生成",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🚀 主な機能",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. Web検索プロバイダー",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "#### DuckDuckGo（デフォルト・APIキー不要）",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "use codex_deep_research::WebSearchProvider;",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "let provider = WebSearchProvider::default();",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "let results = provider.duckduckgo_search_real(\"Rust async programming\", 5).await?;",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "**特徴**:",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ 完全無料（APIキー不要）",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ 即座に利用可能",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ プライバシー保護",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "- ⚡ 応答速度: 1-3秒",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 商用API（オプション）",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "# Brave Search API（推奨）",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "export BRAVE_API_KEY=\"your-api-key\"",
            "lineNumber": 60
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.5767140984535217

        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Deep Research Engine",

          {

          {
            "lineNumber": 4

          {
            "text": "MCP統合リサーチエンジンによる信頼性の高い調査機能。",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🎯 概要",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "Deep Researchはタスク実行前に必要な知識を自動収集し、引用付きで提供します。信頼性0.85以上の結果を保証。",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🔍 動作原理",

          },

            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "    ↓",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "Multi-Source Search (DuckDuckGo, GitHub, Docs)",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "    ↓",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "Content Validation &amp; Synthesis",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "    ↓",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "Citation-Enhanced Response",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🚀 使用方法",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "### 基本リサーチ",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "# Reactベストプラクティス調査",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "codex research \"React Server Components best practices\"",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "# Rust非同期処理調査",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "codex research \"Rust async error handling patterns\"",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "### Plan Modeとの統合",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "# リサーチ付きタスク実行",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan \"Implement React error boundaries\" --research-depth=2",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "# 承認後にリサーチ結果確認",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan export last --format=md",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "### リサーチ設定",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "# 深さ指定",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "codex research \"TypeScript advanced types\" --depth=3",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "# ポリシー指定",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "codex research \"Node.js performance optimization\" --policy=comprehensive",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "# ソース制限",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "codex research \"Web security headers\" --sources=github,mdn",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },

            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",

      "codeBlock": {

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Codex：Sub-Agents &amp; Deep Research 拡張—要件定義書",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "**Status:** Draft · **Audience:** Codex core, cloud, CLI/IDE, integrations, and zapabob maintainers",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "## 0. 背景と目的",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "- OpenAI **Codex** はローカルCLIからIDE拡張、Web/クラウドまで横断する開発者向けエージェント。&#96;AGENTS.md&#96; などでプロジェクト方針を設定し、GitHub連携や @codex による PR レビューなど運用面も拡充している。[1]",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Claude Code** は **Subagents** を標準機能として備え、**個別コンテキスト**・**ツール権限**・**専用システムプロンプト**で委任と並列化を実現する。Codex でも同等以上の一次機能を提供し、トークン予算を**動的配分**して上位互換を狙う。[2]",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Deep Research** は計画立案→多段探索→出典付き要約まで自動化する公式リサーチ機能。軽量版やビジュアルブラウザ連携など最新拡張を取り込み、Codex の公式 Web 検索を**上位互換**として再設計する。[3]",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "- **MCP**（Model Context Protocol）を介して検索・スクレイピング・社内データ源・静的解析器などを安全に接続し、ツール権限を**サーバ側で管理**できるようにする。[9]",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "**目標**：",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "1. Codex に **サブエージェント機構**（トークン動的配分・権限境界・並列実行・PR 分割）を中核機能として組み込む。[2]",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "2. Codex の **Web 検索** を **Deep Research 準拠の計画型探索**へ拡張し、出典必須・反証プローブ・可観測性を備えたリサーチパイプラインを実現する。[3]",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "3. 既存 CLI / IDE / Web / GitHub 動線を壊さず **プラガブル増築**し、&#96;openai/codex&#96; と &#96;zapabob/codex&#96; の両系で保守できるようにする。[1]",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "## 1. スコープ",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "### In Scope",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "- Extend Codex core/orchestrator, CLI, IDE, web, Slack, and GitHub surfaces to expose Sub-Agent delegation and Deep Research without breaking existing entry points.[1]",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "- Provide a declarative configuration format for bundled and user-defined agents (&#96;.codex/agents/*.md|*.yaml&#96;).",
            "lineNumber": 25
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.5510469079017639
    },

      "codeBlock": {

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Brave Search API（推奨）",

          },
          {
            "text": "export BRAVE_API_KEY=\"your-api-key\"",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "# Google Custom Search",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "export GOOGLE_API_KEY=\"your-api-key\"",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "export GOOGLE_CSE_ID=\"your-cse-id\"",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "# Bing Web Search",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "export BING_API_KEY=\"your-api-key\"",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. Deep Research機能",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "text": "# 基本的な使い方（APIキー不要）",
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "codex research \"Rust async best practices\"",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "# Gemini CLI統合（新機能）",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "text": "codex research \"Rust async best practices\" \\",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "  --gemini \\",
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "  --depth 4",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "# 詳細設定",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "text": "codex research \"Rust async\" \\",
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "  --depth 5 \\",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "  --breadth 10 \\",
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "  --budget 60000 \\",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "text": "  --citations \\",
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "  --out report.md",
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "text": "**詳細**: [Gemini CLI統合ガイド](../../docs/gemini-cli-integration.md)",
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "text": "### 3. サブエージェント委譲",
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "text": "# コードレビュー",
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "codex delegate code-reviewer \\",
            "lineNumber": 96
          },
          {
            "text": "  --goal \"Review TypeScript code for security\" \\",
            "lineNumber": 97
          },
          {
            "text": "  --scope ./src \\",
            "lineNumber": 98
          },
          {
            "text": "  --budget 40000",
            "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 100
          },
          {
            "text": "# セキュリティ監査",
            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {
            "text": "codex delegate sec-audit \\",
            "lineNumber": 102
          },
          {
            "text": "  --scope ./backend \\",
            "lineNumber": 103
          },
          {
            "text": "  --out audit-report.json",
            "lineNumber": 104
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 105
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 106
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 107
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 108
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🏁 クイックスタート",
            "lineNumber": 109
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 110
          },
          {
            "text": "### インストール",
            "lineNumber": 111
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 112
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 113
          },
          {
            "text": "# 1. Rustのインストール（未インストールの場合）",
            "lineNumber": 114
          },
          {
            "text": "curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh",
            "lineNumber": 115
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 116
          },
          {
            "text": "# 2. Codexのビルド",
            "lineNumber": 117
          },
          {
            "text": "cd codex-rs",
            "lineNumber": 118
          },
          {
            "text": "cargo build --release -p codex-deep-research",
            "lineNumber": 119
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 120
          },
          {
            "text": "# 3. CLIのグローバルインストール",
            "lineNumber": 121
          },
          {
            "text": "cd ../codex-cli",
            "lineNumber": 122
          },
          {
            "text": "npm install -g .",
            "lineNumber": 123
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 124
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 125
          },
          {
            "text": "### 最初のDeep Research",
            "lineNumber": 126
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 127
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 128
          },
          {
            "text": "# APIキーなしで即座に実行可能！",
            "lineNumber": 129
          },
          {
            "text": "codex research \"What are the latest Rust async best practices?\"",
            "lineNumber": 130
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 131
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 132
          },
          {
            "text": "**出力例**:",
            "lineNumber": 133
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 134
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 135
          },
          {
            "text": "🔍 Starting deep research on: What are the latest Rust async best practices?",
            "lineNumber": 136
          },
          {
            "text": "   Depth: 3, Breadth: 8",
            "lineNumber": 137
          },
          {
            "text": "   Budget: 60000 tokens",
            "lineNumber": 138
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 139
          },
          {
            "text": "🌐 Using Web Search Provider with DuckDuckGo integration",
            "lineNumber": 140
          },
          {
            "text": "   Priority: Brave &gt; Google &gt; Bing &gt; DuckDuckGo (no API key required)",
            "lineNumber": 141
          },
          {
            "text": "   🔓 No API keys found, using DuckDuckGo (free, no API key required)",
            "lineNumber": 142
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 143
          },
          {
            "text": "📋 Research Plan:",
            "lineNumber": 144
          },
          {
            "text": "   Main topic: What are the latest Rust async best practices?",
            "lineNumber": 145
          }
        ]
      },

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\codex-rs\\cli\\src\\research_cmd.rs",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 51,
            "column": 56
