        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "use anyhow::Context;",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "use anyhow::Result;",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "use chrono::Utc;",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "use codex_deep_research::DeepResearcher;",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "use codex_deep_research::DeepResearcherConfig;",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "use codex_deep_research::GeminiSearchProvider;",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "use codex_deep_research::McpSearchProvider;",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "use codex_deep_research::ResearchPlanner;",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "use codex_deep_research::ResearchStrategy;",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "use codex_deep_research::SearchBackend;",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "use codex_deep_research::provider::ResearchProvider;",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "use codex_web_search::WebSearchProvider;",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "use std::path::PathBuf;",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "use std::sync::Arc;",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "pub async fn run_research_command(",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "    topic: String,",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "    depth: u8,",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "    breadth: u8,",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "    budget: usize,",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "    _citations: bool,",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "    mcp_url: Option&lt;String&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "    lightweight_fallback: bool,",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "    out: Option&lt;PathBuf&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "    use_gemini: bool,",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "    use_mcp: bool,",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": ") -&gt; Result&lt;()&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "    println!(\"🔍 Starting deep research on: {}\", topic);",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "    println!(\"   Depth: {}, Breadth: {}\", depth, breadth);",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "    println!(\"   Budget: {} tokens\", budget);",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "    let plan = ResearchPlanner::generate_plan(&amp;topic, depth, breadth as usize)",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "        .context(\"Failed to generate research plan\")?;",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "    println!(\"\\n📋 Research Plan:\");",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "    println!(\"   Main topic: {}\", plan.main_topic);",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "    println!(\"   Sub-queries ({}):\", plan.sub_queries.len());",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "    for (i, query) in plan.sub_queries.iter().enumerate() {",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "        println!(\"     {}. {}\", i + 1, query);",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "    let actual_plan = if lightweight_fallback &amp;&amp; budget &lt; 30_000 {",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "        println!(\"\\n⚡ Using lightweight research mode due to budget constraints\");",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "        ResearchPlanner::downgrade_to_lightweight(&amp;plan)",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "    } else {",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "        plan",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "    };",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Provider selection priority: Gemini CLI -&gt; MCP search -&gt; built-in web search.",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "    let provider: Arc&lt;dyn ResearchProvider + Send + Sync&gt; = if use_gemini {",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "        let model =",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "            std::env::var(\"GEMINI_MODEL\").unwrap_or_else",
            "lineNumber": 52
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.5328778624534607

            "text": "**5分で始めるCodex Deep Research &amp; サブエージェント機能**",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📋 目次",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "1. [インストール](#インストール)",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "2. [Deep Research - 基本編](#deep-research---基本編)",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "3. [Deep Research - 応用編](#deep-research---応用編)",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "4. [サブエージェント - 基本編](#サブエージェント---基本編)",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "5. [サブエージェント - 応用編](#サブエージェント---応用編)",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "6. [カスタムコマンド一覧](#カスタムコマンド一覧)",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "## 1️⃣ インストール",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "### 必要なもの",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "- Rust 1.76+ （[rustup.rs](https://rustup.rs)）",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "- Node.js 18+ （npm）",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "- Git",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "### インストール手順",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "# 1. リポジトリをクローン",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "git clone https://github.com/zapabob/codex.git",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "cd codex",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "# 2. Rustコンポーネントをビルド",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "cd codex-rs",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "cargo build --release -p codex-deep-research",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "# 3. CLIをグローバルインストール",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "cd ../codex-cli",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "npm install -g .",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "# 4. 動作確認",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "codex --version",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "**期待される出力**:",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "codex 0.47.0-alpha.1",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "## 2️⃣ Deep Research - 基本編",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "### 最初のDeep Research（APIキー不要）",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "codex research \"What are Rust async best practices?\"",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "**実行結果**:",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "🔍 Starting deep research on: What are Rust async best practices?",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "   Depth: 3, Breadth: 8",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "   Budget: 60000 tokens",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "🌐 Using Web Search Provider with DuckDuckGo integration",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "   Priority: Brave &gt; Google &gt; Bing &gt; DuckDuckGo (no API key required)",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "   🔓 No API keys found, using DuckDuckGo (free, no API key required)",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 71

          {

          },
          {
            "text": "   Confidence: High",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "💾 Report saved to: artifacts/report.md",

            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "## 3️⃣ Deep Research - 応用編",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "### 深い調査（Depth 5）",

          },

          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",

          },
          {

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\codex-subagents-deep-research.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 87
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 113
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "- **Integration Layer**: bridges GitHub PR bots, Slack notifiers, IDE panes, and web dashboards with consistent telemetry schemas.[6]",
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Evidence Store**: archives source URLs, snippets, screenshots, confidence scores, and decision rationale for downstream consumption.[10]",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "## External Interfaces",
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "text": "- **SDK (TypeScript/Node, Go planned)**: &#96;delegate()&#96;, &#96;research()&#96;, &#96;plan()&#96;, &#96;submitPR()&#96;, &#96;measure()&#96;, and &#96;defineAgent()&#96; for runtime agent creation.",
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "- **CLI**: &#96;codex research \"&lt;topic&gt;\" --depth &lt;n&gt; --budget &lt;tokens&gt; --citations required&#96;, &#96;codex delegate &lt;agent&gt; --scope &lt;path&gt; --deadline &lt;duration&gt;&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "text": "- **IDE**: command palette entries (Research, Delegate, Compare Plans, Insert Citations) and side panels for plan progress and evidence review.[1]",
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "- **GitHub Bot**: &#96;@codex run research: &lt;topic&gt;&#96; and &#96;@codex delegate: &lt;agent&gt;&#96; comment verbs with status threads and attachments.[6]",
            "lineNumber": 96
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 97
          },
          {
            "text": "## Deep Research Data Flow",
            "lineNumber": 98
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Goal intake** -&gt; 2. **Plan generation** (sub-queries, success criteria) -&gt; 3. **Acquisition** (search, crawl, fetch PDFs/images) -&gt; 4. **Extraction** (key facts, quantitative data) -&gt; 5. **Cross-check &amp; refutation** -&gt; 6. **Report synthesis** (mandatory citations) -&gt; 7. **Feedback loop** for follow-up questions.[3]",
            "lineNumber": 100
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {
            "text": "## Security &amp; Compliance Considerations",
            "lineNumber": 102
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 103
          },
          {
            "text": "- Maintain per-agent manifests describing granted capabilities and audit logs for every privileged operation.[7]",
            "lineNumber": 104
          },
          {
            "text": "- Enforce multi-domain corroboration for timely or news content; flag single-source claims for reviewer attention.[10]",
            "lineNumber": 105
          },
          {
            "text": "- Require citations for all surfaced conclusions; reports must embed URL, retrieval timestamp, and confidence metadata.[3]",
            "lineNumber": 106
          },
          {
            "text": "- Support redaction tooling so outputs destined for external surfaces (e.g., GitHub comments) strip sensitive repository paths or secrets by default.[5]",
            "lineNumber": 107
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 108
          },
          {
            "text": "## Rollout and Compatibility",
            "lineNumber": 109
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 110
          },
          {
            "text": "- Ship behind feature flags (e.g., &#96;CODEX_AGENT_RUNTIME&#96;, &#96;CODEX_DEEP_RESEARCH&#96;) with per-surface enablement toggles.",
            "lineNumber": 111
          },
          {
            "text": "- Pilot in &#96;zapabob/codex&#96; forks to validate developer ergonomics before upstream PRs; keep configuration format stable to minimize merge drift.",
            "lineNumber": 112
          },
          {
            "text": "- Provide migration guides for existing users: default configuration yields current single-agent behavior until explicit agent definitions are added.",
            "lineNumber": 113
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.5263230204582214
    },

      "codeBlock": {

        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Codex Sub-Agents &amp; Deep Research Configuration",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "このディレクトリには、Codexのサブエージェント機能とDeep Research拡張の設定ファイルが格納されています。",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📁 ディレクトリ構造",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": ".codex/",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "├── agents/           # サブエージェント定義（YAML）",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "│   ├── researcher.yaml",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "│   ├── test-gen.yaml",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "│   └── sec-audit.yaml",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "├── policies/         # 権限・許可リスト",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "│   ├── net.allowlist",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "│   └── mcp.allowlist",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "├── prompts/          # システムプロンプト",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "│   ├── meta-prompt.md",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "│   └── starter-kit.md",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "└── scripts/          # 実行スクリプト",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "    ├── run_research.sh",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "    └── run_delegate.sh",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🚀 使い方",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "### Deep Research実行",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "# 基本的な使用法",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "codex research \"調査したいトピック\" --depth 3 --budget 60000",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "# スクリプト経由",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "bash .codex/scripts/run_research.sh \"Rustのプロセス分離 2023-2025比較\"",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "### サブエージェント委任",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "# テスト生成エージェントに委任",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "codex delegate test-gen --scope ./src --deadline 2h",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "# セキュリティ監査エージェントに委任",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "codex delegate sec-audit --scope ./src --budget 40000",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "# コードレビューエージェントに委任",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "codex delegate code-reviewer --scope ./src --out artifacts/code-review.md",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "# スクリプト経由",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "bash .codex/scripts/run_delegate.sh sec-audit",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🔧 サブエージェント設定",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. Deep Researcher",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "- **目的**: 計画的な多段探索と反証でレポート作成",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "- **ツール**: MCP検索, クローラー, PDFリーダー",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "- **出力**: &#96;artifacts/report.md&#96;, &#96;artifacts/evidence/*.json&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. Test Generator",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "- **目的**: 差分に対するユニット/回帰テスト自動生成",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "- **ツール**: コードインデクサ, npm/pytest/cargo/go",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "- **成功基準**: CI green, カバレッジ+10%",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "### 3. Security Auditor",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "- **目的**: CVE横断・依存監査・静的解析",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "- **ツール**: snyk, trivy, safety, bandit",
            "lineNumber": 66
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.5210562944412231
    },

          {

          },
          {
            "text": "//! This custom Plan module extends the official Plan Mode collaboration template",

            "text": "//! while maintaining alignment with the official 2-phase conversational approach.",

          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "//! ### Official Plan Mode Structure",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "//! The official Plan Mode (improved in commits #9877, #9874) uses a conversational",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "//! 2-phase approach:",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "//! 1. **PHASE 1 — Intent chat**: Understand what the user actually wants",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "//!    - Goal + success criteria, audience, in/out of scope, constraints, current state",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "//!    - Key preferences/tradeoffs",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "//!    - Bias toward questions over guessing",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "//! 2. **PHASE 2 — Implementation chat**: Technical spec and implementation plan",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "//!    - Approach, interfaces (APIs/schemas/I/O), data flow",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "//!    - Edge cases/failure modes, testing + acceptance criteria",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "//!    - Rollout/monitoring, migrations/compat constraints",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "//! ### Key Principles from Official Improvements",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Ask a lot, but never ask trivia**: Questions must materially change the spec/plan,",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "//!   confirm/lock assumptions, or choose between meaningful tradeoffs",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Batch questions**: 4-10 questions per &#96;request_user_input&#96; call to keep momentum",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Two kinds of unknowns**:",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "//!   1. Discoverable facts: Explore first (≥2 targeted searches) before asking",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "//!   2. Preferences/tradeoffs: Ask early with 2-4 options + recommended default",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Finalization rule**: Only output final plan when remaining unknowns are low-impact",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "//!   and explicitly listed as assumptions",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 43

          },

            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "**Version**: 0.57.0",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "## Command Index",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "| Command | Purpose | Args Required |",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "|---------|---------|---------------|",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;/Plan on\\|off&#96; | Toggle mode | None |",

          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;/Plan \"title\"&#96; | Create Plan | Title/goal |",

          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;/approve &lt;bp-id&gt;&#96; | Approve | Plan ID |",

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;/Plan export&#96; | Export files | Plan ID |",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;/mode &lt;mode&gt;&#96; | Set exec mode | Mode name |",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;/deepresearch \"query\"&#96; | Research | Query string |",

          },
          {
            "text": "---",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "## &#96;/Plan on|off&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "Toggle plan mode on/off.",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "### Syntax",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "/Plan on",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "/Plan off",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "### Behavior",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "- **ON**: Enters plan mode, all operations become read-only until approved",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "- **OFF**: Exits plan mode, returns to normal operation",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "### Examples",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "# Enable plan mode",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan on",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "# Disable plan mode",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan off",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46
          },

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "## &#96;/Plan \"&lt;title&gt;\" [options]&#96;",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "Create a new Plan.",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "### Syntax",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "/Plan \"&lt;title or goal&gt;\" [--mode=&lt;mode&gt;] [--budget.tokens=&lt;N&gt;] [--budget.time=&lt;minutes&gt;]",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "### Parameters",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "|-----------|------|---------|-------------|",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;title&#96; | string | Required | Plan title or goal |",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;--mode&#96; | enum | orchestrated | Execution mode: single, orchestrated, competition |",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;--budget.tokens&#96; | number | 100000 | Session token cap |",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;--budget.time&#96; | number | 30 | Time cap in minutes |",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "### Examples",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "# Minimal (use defaults)",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan \"Add request logging\"",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "# With mode",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan \"Refactor auth\" --mode=orchestrated",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "text": "# With custom budget",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan \"Optimize query\" --mode=competition --budget.tokens=150000 --budget.time=60",
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "text": "# Single mode for simple task",
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan \"Fix typo in README\" --mode=single",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 83
          },

            "text": "### Output",

            "lineNumber": 85

          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 93
          },

    {

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Execution Modes - Detailed Guide",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "**Version**: 0.57.0",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "## Overview",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "plan mode supports 3 execution strategies, each optimized for different use cases.",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "| Mode | Use Case | Speed | Quality | Complexity |",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "|------|----------|-------|---------|------------|",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "| **Single** | Simple edits | ⚡⚡⚡ | ⭐⭐ | Low |",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "| **Orchestrated** | Complex features | ⚡⚡ | ⭐⭐⭐ | Medium |",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "| **Competition** | Optimization | ⚡ | ⭐⭐⭐⭐ | High |",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "## Single Mode",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "### When to Use",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ Single-file changes",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ Typo fixes, docstring additions",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ Simple refactoring (rename variable)",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ Quick iterations",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "### Architecture",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "Plan (approved)",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "    ↓",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "Single LLM Agent",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "    ↓",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "File edits + tests",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "    ↓",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "Done",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "### Example",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "**Task**: Add docstring to a function",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan \"Add docstring to calculate_total()\" --mode=single",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "**Execution**:",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "1. Single agent reads function",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "2. Generates docstring",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "3. Applies patch",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "4. Runs linter",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "5. Done in ~30 seconds",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "## Orchestrated Mode (Default)",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "### When to Use",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ Multi-file features",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ Full-stack changes (backend + frontend)",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ Database migrations",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ Security-sensitive code",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ Test generation required",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "### Architecture",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "Plan (approved)",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "    ↓",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "Central Planner",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "text": "    ├── Task DAG",
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "    └── Sub-Agent Assignments",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "        ↓",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "Parallel Execution",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "text": "├─ Backend Agent    → API changes",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "├─ Frontend Agent   → UI updates",
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "├─ Database Agent   → Schema migrations",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "text": "├─ Security Agent   → Vulnerability review",
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "└─ QA Agent         → Test generation",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "text": "    ↓",
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "Integrator",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "├─ Collect patches",
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "├─ Run linters/tests",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "text": "└─ Prepare PR",
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "    ↓",
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "text": "Done",
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "### Example",
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "text": "**Task**: Migrate session auth to JWT",
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan \"Refactor auth to JWT\" --mode=orchestrated",
            "lineNumber": 96
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 97
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 98
          },
          {
            "text": "**Execution Flow**:",
            "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 100
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Planner** analyzes Plan",
            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Identifies 5 work items (JWT service, DB migration, API endpoints, frontend client, tests)",
            "lineNumber": 102
          }
        ]
      },

      "codeBlock": {

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "//! Plan schema definitions",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "//! Defines the core data structures for plan mode, including the",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "//! PlanBlock which represents a complete planning artifact.",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "//! ## Alignment with Official Plan Mode",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "//! The &#96;PlanBlock&#96; structure captures the structured output from the official Plan Mode",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "//! collaboration template. Key fields align with the 2-phase approach:",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Phase 1 (Intent)**: &#96;goal&#96;, &#96;assumptions&#96;, &#96;clarifying_questions&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - **Phase 2 (Implementation)**: &#96;approach&#96;, &#96;work_items&#96;, &#96;risks&#96;, &#96;eval&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "//! The &#96;clarifying_questions&#96; field should contain questions that:",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - Materially change the spec/plan, OR",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - Confirm/lock an assumption, OR",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - Choose between meaningful tradeoffs",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "//! Questions should be batched (4-10 per interaction) to maintain momentum, following",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "//! the official Plan Mode improvements from commits #9877 and #9874.",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "use chrono::DateTime;",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "use chrono::Utc;",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "use serde::Deserialize;",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "use serde::Serialize;",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "use std::collections::HashMap;",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "/// Execution mode for Plan execution",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "#[serde(rename_all = \"snake_case\")]",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "pub enum ExecutionMode {",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Single agent, no orchestration",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "    Single,",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Orchestrated control with central planner + sub-agents",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "    Orchestrated,",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Worktree competition with multiple variants",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "    Competition,",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "impl Default for ExecutionMode {",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "    fn default() -&gt; Self {",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "        Self::Orchestrated",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "impl std::fmt::Display for ExecutionMode {",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "    fn fmt(&amp;self, f: &amp;mut std::fmt::Formatter&lt;'_&gt;) -&gt; std::fmt::Result {",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "        match self {",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "            Self::Single =&gt; write!(f, \"single\"),",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "            Self::Orchestrated =&gt; write!(f, \"orchestrated\"),",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "            Self::Competition =&gt; write!(f, \"competition\"),",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "/// A single work item in the Plan",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "pub struct WorkItem {",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Work item name",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "    pub name: String,",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Files that will be touched",
            "lineNumber": 61
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.4927467107772827
    },

          },

            "text": "//!",

          },
          {
            "text": "//! Provides command-line interface for creating, managing, and executing plan.",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "use anyhow::Context;",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "use anyhow::Result;",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "use clap::Parser;",

          },
          {
            "text": "use clap::Subcommand;",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "/// Plan Mode commands",

          },
          {
            "text": "#[derive(Debug, Parser)]",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "pub struct PlanCli {",

          },
          {
            "text": "    #[clap(subcommand)]",

          },
          {

            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "#[derive(Debug, Subcommand)]",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "pub enum PlanCommand {",

          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Toggle plan mode on/off",

          {
            "text": "    },",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Create a new Plan",

          },
          {
            "text": "    Create {",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "        /// Plan title or goal",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "        title: String,",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "        /// Execution mode (single, orchestrated, competition)",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "        #[clap(long, default_value = \"orchestrated\", value_parser = parse_execution_mode)]",

          },
          {
            "text": "        mode: ExecutionMode,",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "        /// Token budget",

          },
          {
            "text": "        #[clap(long, default_value = \"100000\")]",

          },
          {
            "text": "        budget_tokens: u64,",

          {

          },

          },
          {
            "text": "        #[clap(long, default_value = \"30\")]",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "        budget_time: u64,",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "    },",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// List all Plans",

          },
          {
            "text": "    List {",

          {

          },
          {
            "text": "        #[clap(long)]",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "        state: Option&lt;String&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "    },",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Approve a Plan",

          },
          {
            "text": "    Approve {",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "        /// Plan ID",

          },
          {
            "text": "        plan_id: String,",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "    },",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Reject a Plan",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "    Reject {",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "        /// Plan ID",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "        plan_id: String,",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "        /// Rejection reason",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "        #[clap(long)]",

          },
          {
            "text": "        reason: String,",

          },
          {
            "text": "    },",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Export a Plan",

          },
          {
            "text": "    Export {",

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "        /// Export format (md, json, both)",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "text": "        #[clap(long, default_value = \"both\")]",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "        format: String,",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "text": "        /// Export path",

          },
          {

          },

          },

          },

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "//! Plan state machine",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "//! Defines the finite state machine for Plan lifecycle management.",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "//! State transitions are strictly controlled to ensure safety and proper approvals.",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "use chrono::DateTime;",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "use chrono::Utc;",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "use serde::Deserialize;",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "use serde::Serialize;",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "use thiserror::Error;",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "/// Plan state machine states",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "#[serde(tag = \"status\", rename_all = \"snake_case\")]",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "pub enum PlanState {",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Plan is inactive/not started",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "    Inactive,",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Plan is being drafted",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "    Drafting,",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Plan is pending approval",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "    Pending {",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "        /// Timestamp when moved to pending",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "        pending_since: DateTime&lt;Utc&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "    },",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Plan has been approved for execution",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "    Approved {",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "        /// Who approved it",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "        approved_by: String,",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "        /// When it was approved",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "        approved_at: DateTime&lt;Utc&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "    },",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Plan was rejected",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "    Rejected {",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "        /// Reason for rejection",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "        reason: String,",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "        /// Who rejected it",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "        rejected_by: Option&lt;String&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "        /// When it was rejected",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "        rejected_at: DateTime&lt;Utc&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "    },",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Plan was superseded by a new version",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "    Superseded {",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "        /// ID of the new Plan",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "        new_id: String,",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "        /// When it was superseded",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "        superseded_at: DateTime&lt;Utc&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "    },",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Plan is currently executing",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "    Executing {",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "        /// Execution ID",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "        execution_id: String,",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "        /// When execution started",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "        started_at: DateTime&lt;Utc&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "    },",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Plan execution completed successfully",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "    Completed {",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "        /// Execution ID",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "        execution_id: String,",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "        /// When execution completed",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "        completed_at: DateTime&lt;Utc&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "    },",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "    /// Plan execution failed",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "    Failed {",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "        /// Execution ID",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "text": "        execution_id: String,",
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "        /// Error message",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "        error: String,",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "        /// When execution failed",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "text": "        failed_at: DateTime&lt;Utc&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "    },",
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "impl Default for PlanState {",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "text": "    fn default() -&gt; Self",
            "lineNumber": 82
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.48462769389152527
