    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\.cursor\\skills\\plan-mode\\SKILL.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 42
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "name: plan-mode",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "description: Create comprehensive project plans using Cursor/ClaudeCode-style 2-phase conversational approach. Use when planning complex projects, breaking down large tasks, or managing multi-step workflows with dependencies and timelines. Follows official Plan Mode structure with Intent chat (Phase 1) and Implementation chat (Phase 2).",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "# Plan Mode (Cursor/ClaudeCode Style)",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "This skill enables Cursor/ClaudeCode-style advanced project planning using a **2-phase conversational approach**. You work in 2 phases and should *chat your way* to a great plan before finalizing it.",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "## Hard Interaction Rule (Critical)",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "Every assistant turn MUST be exactly one of:",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "- **A)** a &#96;request_user_input&#96; tool call (questions/options only), OR",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "- **B)** the final output: a titled, plan-only document.",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "Rules:",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "- No questions in free text (only via &#96;request_user_input&#96;)",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "- Never mix a &#96;request_user_input&#96; call with plan content",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "- Internal tool/repo exploration is allowed privately before A or B",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "## PHASE 1 — Intent Chat (What They Actually Want)",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "Keep asking until you can clearly state:",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Goal + Success Criteria**: What is the objective and how do we measure success?",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Audience**: Who is this for? Who are the stakeholders?",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "- **In/Out of Scope**: What's included and what's explicitly excluded?",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Constraints**: Time, budget, resource, and quality constraints",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Current State**: What exists now? What's the baseline?",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Key Preferences/Tradeoffs**: Important decisions and their implications",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "### Phase 1 Principles",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Bias toward questions over guessing**: If any high-impact ambiguity remains, do NOT plan yet—ask.",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Include a \"Confirm my understanding\" question**: In each round, include a confirmation question so the user can correct you early.",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **Ask a lot, but never ask trivia**: Each question must:",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Materially change the spec/plan, OR",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Confirm/lock an assumption, OR",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Choose between meaningful tradeoffs",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "4. **Batch questions**: 4-10 questions per &#96;request_user_input&#96; call to keep momentum.",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "### Two Kinds of Unknowns (Treat Differently)",
            "lineNumber": 41
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.4845702052116394
    },
    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\README.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 40
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Codex (zapabob fork) — AI-Native Development Platform",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "**For AI tech recruiters (Sakana AI, AMD, etc.)**: This repo demonstrates **production-grade multi-agent orchestration** with unique innovations in conflict prevention, quality competition, and parallel development workflows.",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "**AIテック企業採用担当者向け**: 本リポジトリは、**コンフリクト予防、品質競争、並列開発ワークフロー**における独自のイノベーションを含む、**プロダクショングレードのマルチエージェントオーケストレーション**を実装しています。",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🎯 Unique Differentiators（独自性）",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. **Plan Mode with Approval Gates** / 承認ゲート付きPlan Mode",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "**What it is**: 3-phase workflow (Planning → Approval → Execution) with **zero side effects** until human approval.",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "**独自性**: 計画段階は副作用なし、承認後にのみ実行。運用前提のガードレール設計。",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Implementation**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/plan/&#96; - Budget management, execution logging, audit trail",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Quickstart**: &#96;docs/plan/README.md&#96; (5-minute reproducible guide)",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. **Deep Research Engine** / Deep Researchエンジン",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "**What it is**: Multi-source research with citation management, contradiction detection, and 15+ MCP server integration.",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "**独自性**: 引用管理と矛盾検出機能を持つマルチソースリサーチエンジン。15以上のMCPサーバーを統合。",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Implementation**: &#96;codex-rs/deep-research/&#96; - Multi-source validation, evidence synthesis",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Features**: Citation tracking, source validation, intelligent caching",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Usage**: &#96;codex research \"React Server Components best practices\" --depth 3&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "### 3. **Parallel Sub-Agents with Specialization** / 専門化された並列サブエージェント",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "**What it is**: Specialized AI agents (Backend/Frontend/Database/Security/QA) execute in parallel with conflict resolution.",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "**独自性**: 専門AIエージェント（Backend/Frontend/Database/Security/QA）が並列実行され、コンフリクト解決を内蔵。",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Implementation**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/agents/&#96; - AgentRuntime, parallel executor, conflict resolver",
            "lineNumber": 40
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.480094313621521
    },
    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\plan\\dev\\architecture.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 294
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 377
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "### 5. Webhooks (&#96;codex-rs/core/src/webhooks/&#96;)",
            "lineNumber": 295
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 296
          },
          {
            "text": "#### Send Flow",
            "lineNumber": 297
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 298
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 299
          },
          {
            "text": "WebhookClient.send(config, payload)",
            "lineNumber": 300
          },
          {
            "text": "    │",
            "lineNumber": 301
          },
          {
            "text": "    ▼",
            "lineNumber": 302
          },
          {
            "text": "Retry Loop (max 3 attempts)",
            "lineNumber": 303
          },
          {
            "text": "│",
            "lineNumber": 304
          },
          {
            "text": "├─ Attempt 1 (0s delay)",
            "lineNumber": 305
          },
          {
            "text": "│   ├─ Format payload (GitHub/Slack/HTTP)",
            "lineNumber": 306
          },
          {
            "text": "│   ├─ Compute HMAC-SHA256",
            "lineNumber": 307
          },
          {
            "text": "│   ├─ Send POST request",
            "lineNumber": 308
          },
          {
            "text": "│   └─ Check response status",
            "lineNumber": 309
          },
          {
            "text": "│       ├─ Success → Done",
            "lineNumber": 310
          },
          {
            "text": "│       └─ Error → Retry",
            "lineNumber": 311
          },
          {
            "text": "│",
            "lineNumber": 312
          },
          {
            "text": "├─ Attempt 2 (1s delay)",
            "lineNumber": 313
          },
          {
            "text": "│   └─ ...",
            "lineNumber": 314
          },
          {
            "text": "│",
            "lineNumber": 315
          },
          {
            "text": "└─ Attempt 3 (2s delay)",
            "lineNumber": 316
          },
          {
            "text": "    └─ ... (exponential backoff)",
            "lineNumber": 317
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 318
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 319
          },
          {
            "text": "#### HMAC Signature",
            "lineNumber": 320
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 321
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 322
          },
          {
            "text": "fn compute_hmac(secret: &amp;str, body: &amp;str) -&gt; String {",
            "lineNumber": 323
          },
          {
            "text": "    let mut mac = Hmac::&lt;Sha256&gt;::new_from_slice(secret.as_bytes());",
            "lineNumber": 324
          },
          {
            "text": "    mac.update(body.as_bytes());",
            "lineNumber": 325
          },
          {
            "text": "    hex::encode(mac.finalize().into_bytes())",
            "lineNumber": 326
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 327
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 328
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 329
          },
          {
            "text": "Sent as header:",
            "lineNumber": 330
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 331
          },
          {
            "text": "X-Codex-Signature: sha256=&lt;hmac-hex&gt;",
            "lineNumber": 332
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 333
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 334
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 335
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 336
          },
          {
            "text": "## Data Flow",
            "lineNumber": 337
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 338
          },
          {
            "text": "### Plan Creation → Execution",
            "lineNumber": 339
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 340
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 341
          },
          {
            "text": "1. User: /Plan \"Add feature\" --mode=orchestrated",
            "lineNumber": 342
          },
          {
            "text": "       ↓",
            "lineNumber": 343
          },
          {
            "text": "2. VS Code Extension: commands.ts",
            "lineNumber": 344
          },
          {

          {

          },
          {
            "text": "## Execution Modes",

          {

          {
            "text": "### Single Mode",

          {
            "lineNumber": 242
          },
          {
            "text": "**Use Case**: Simple, single-file changes",

            "lineNumber": 244
          },
          {
            "text": "**Behavior**:",
            "lineNumber": 245
          },
          {
            "text": "- No sub-agents",

          {

          {
            "text": "- Fast execution",
            "lineNumber": 248

          {
            "lineNumber": 249
          },
          {

          {

          {
            "lineNumber": 254
          },

          },

          },

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 264
          },

          },

            "text": "    pub(crate) fn transform(",

          },

            "text": "    ) -&gt; Result&lt;ExecEnv, SandboxTransformError&gt; {",

          },
          {
            "text": "        if !policy.has_full_network_access() {",

          },
          {

          },

          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 133
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 134
          },
          {
            "text": "        let mut command = Vec::with_capacity(1 + spec.args.len());",
            "lineNumber": 135
          },
          {
            "text": "        command.push(spec.program);",
            "lineNumber": 136
          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 138
          },

          {

          },
          {

          },

          },

          },

          },

          },
          {

          },

          }
        ]

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\zapabob\\codex-feature-integration-spec-ja.md",
        "range": {

            "line": 39

        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "- サンドボックスと承認メカニズム: 本家Codexはセキュリティ上の配慮から、デフォルトではファイルの読み書きやコマンド実行の権限を現在のプロジェクトディレクトリ内に制限しています 。エージェントはOSごとの仕組み（macOSならSeatbeltによるsandbox-exec、Linuxならseccomp/Landlock等）で隔離された環境下でコマンドを実行し 、ネットワークアクセスも標準では無効化されています  。ユーザはCodexに与えるフラグや設定ファイル（config.toml）でサンドボックスのモードを変更可能です。例えば--sandbox read-onlyを指定すればエージェントを読み取り専用モードで起動できます 。また承認（Approval）ポリシーにより、エージェントが実行しようとする操作に対するユーザ確認のタイミングを制御できます 。デフォルト設定（Autoモード）では、エージェントはワークスペース内のファイル読み書きと安全なコマンド実行は自動で行いますが、外部への書き込みやネットワークアクセス等「信頼できない操作」を実行する際にはユーザに許可を求めます 。ユーザは--ask-for-approvalオプションでalways（常に許可確認）、never（一切確認しない）、untrusted（デフォルト）等を選択可能であり、危険度に応じてエージェントの自律性を調整できます 。極端なケースでは、--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox（エイリアス: --yolo）オプションにより全てのサンドボックス制限と承認確認を無効化することもできます （推奨されません）。",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "- Gitおよび開発ワークフローとの統合: CodexはGit管理下のフォルダで動作することを想定しており、エージェントはgit status等を内部的に確認して作業ブランチがクリーンかどうか検知し、モードを自動調整する仕組みがあります 。例えば、Gitでバージョン管理されているフォルダではデフォルトの承認ポリシーをAutoに設定し、そうでない場合はRead-Onlyモードを推奨する、といった挙動です 。またCodexはコード変更時にできるだけ**差分パッチ（git diff形式）**を生成し、それを適用する形でファイルを書き換えます。これは、大きな変更を直接ファイルに書き込むのではなく、小さな変更単位でパッチを作成・適用することで、人間によるレビューやロールバックを容易にするためです 。ユーザにはエージェントの提案を一種のPull Requestと見なして、小まめにテストやレビューを行い、コミットメッセージに経緯を残す、といった運用が推奨されています 。",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "- パフォーマンス: 本家Codex (Rust実装)のパフォーマンスは対話型ツールとして十分高速ですが、zapabob版の分析ではデバッグビルド時にバイナリサイズが80MB近くになること、また一部警告が残っていることが指摘されています 。起動時間もチューニングの余地があり、本家版では標準的なマシンで数百ミリ秒程度と推定されます。なお2025年1月時点の最新版Codexのアップデートで、モデル応答の安定性やコラボレーション性能の向上が図られています が、エージェントの根本的な実行モデル（単一対話エージェント）に大きな変化はありません。",
            "lineNumber": 42
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.5127398371696472
    },
    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\zapabob\\2025-10-07_Rust実装改善ロードマップ.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},

        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Codex Rust実装 改善ロードマップ",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "**日時**: 2025年10月8日 0:10 JST  ",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "**作業者**: AI Assistant (なんJ風) + ボブにゃんのフィードバック  ",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "**目的**: 実務レベルのCLI型AIシステムへの昇華",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🎯 なぜRustなのか（再確認）",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "ボブにゃんの言う通り、**Codexが",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "Rustを選んだのはほぼ必然**や：",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "### 三点セット",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **単一バイナリ配布** - 依存地獄からの解放",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **ネイティブな権限制御** - OS直結の安全策",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **低オーバーヘッド** - LLMはクラウド側で重いから、クライアント側は軽く",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "### 現状の成果",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "✅ &#96;enum&#96;による厳格な型システム  ",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "✅ &#96;Box::pin&#96;で再帰async制御  ",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "✅ Tokioによる並列・進捗管理  ",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "✅ ユニットテスト24/24パス（100%）  ",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "**→ \"壊れにくい土台\"は既に形成済み**",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🚀 実装優先度（実務目線）",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "### 優先度1: 脅威モデル → 既定サンドボックス 🔐",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "**現状**:",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;SandboxPolicy&#96;は定義済み",
            "lineNumber": 34

        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\codex-rs\\core\\README.md",
        "range": {

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# codex-core",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "This crate implements the business logic for Codex. It is designed to be used by the various Codex UIs written in Rust.",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "## Dependencies",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "Note that &#96;codex-core&#96; makes some assumptions about certain helper utilities being available in the environment. Currently, this support matrix is:",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "### macOS",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "Expects &#96;/usr/bin/sandbox-exec&#96; to be present.",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "When using the workspace-write sandbox policy, the Seatbelt profile allows",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "writes under the configured writable roots while keeping &#96;.git&#96; (directory or",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "pointer file), the resolved &#96;gitdir:&#96; target, and &#96;.codex&#96; read-only.",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "### Linux",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "Expects the binary containing &#96;codex-core&#96; to run the equivalent of &#96;codex sandbox linux&#96; (legacy alias: &#96;codex debug landlock&#96;) when &#96;arg0&#96; is &#96;codex-linux-sandbox&#96;. See the &#96;codex-arg0&#96; crate for details.",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "### All Platforms",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "Expects the binary containing &#96;codex-core&#96; to simulate the virtual &#96;apply_patch&#96; CLI when &#96;arg1&#96; is &#96;--codex-run-as-apply-patch&#96;. See the &#96;codex-arg0&#96; crate for details.",
            "lineNumber": 23
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.5063179731369019
    },

          {
            "text": "---",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 374
          },
          {
            "text": "### 📊 技術スタック",
            "lineNumber": 375
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 376
          },
          {
            "text": "| レイヤー | 技術 | 目的 |",
            "lineNumber": 377
          },
          {
            "text": "|---------|------|------|",
            "lineNumber": 378
          },
          {
            "text": "| **コアランタイム** | Rust (Tokio) | 非同期実行・パフォーマンス最適化 |",
            "lineNumber": 379
          },
          {
            "text": "| **UI (ターミナル)** | Ratatui | インタラクティブターミナル UI |",
            "lineNumber": 380
          },
          {
            "text": "| **UI (IDE)** | TypeScript | VS Code/Cursor/Windsurf 拡張 |",
            "lineNumber": 381
          },
          {
            "text": "| **SDK** | Node.js (N-API) | Rust↔Node.js 連携 |",
            "lineNumber": 382
          },
          {
            "text": "| **プロトコル** | MCP (JSON-RPC) | エージェント間通信 |",
            "lineNumber": 383
          },
          {
            "text": "| **オーケストレーション** | DashMap | スレッドセーフな状態管理 |",
            "lineNumber": 384
          },
          {
            "text": "| **サンドボックス** | Seatbelt/Landlock | macOS/Linux セキュリティ分離 |",
            "lineNumber": 385
          },
          {
            "text": "| **AI モデル** | OpenAI/Anthropic | GPT-4/5、Claude |",
            "lineNumber": 386
          },
          {
            "text": "| **Web 検索** | DuckDuckGo API | Deep Research 機能 |",
            "lineNumber": 387
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 388
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 389
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 390
          },
          {
            "text": "### 📁 プロジェクト構成",
            "lineNumber": 391
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 392
          },
          {
            "text": "*(英語版と同じプロジェクト構造)*",

          },
          {
            "text": "---",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 396
          },
          {
            "text": "### 🔒 セキュリティ＆サンドボックス",
            "lineNumber": 397
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 398
          },
          {
            "text": "Codex は複数層の保護でセキュリティを最優先：",
            "lineNumber": 399
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 400
          },
          {
            "text": "- **サンドボックス分離**: Seatbelt (macOS)、Landlock (Linux)",
            "lineNumber": 401
          },
          {
            "text": "- **承認ポリシー**: &#96;on-request&#96;、&#96;on-failure&#96;、&#96;never&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 402
          },
          {
            "text": "- **ネットワーク制限**: &#96;full-auto&#96; モードでデフォルト無効",
            "lineNumber": 403
          },
          {
            "text": "- **ファイルシステム保護**: ワークスペースディレクトリに限定",
            "lineNumber": 404
          },
          {
            "text": "- **監査ログ**: すべてのアクションをレビュー用にログ記録",

## 完了：VSIX拡張機能統合

### 実装内容

1. **Cowork統合モジュール** (`src/cowork/manager.ts`)
   - ブラウザ自動化（navigate, automate）
   - ドキュメント生成（Excel, Word, PowerPoint）
   - 外部サービス統合（Asana, Notion）
   - セッション管理

2. **macOS風サンドボックス管理** (`src/sandbox/manager.ts`)
   - プラットフォーム自動検出（macOS Seatbelt、Linux seccomp、Windows Restricted Token）
   - ネットワーク/インターネット/ファイルシステムアクセス制御
   - パス許可/拒否管理

3. **Deep Research強化**
   - 研究履歴の実装（RPC統合）
   - 承認ダイアログ統合
   - Gemini統合オプション
   - 深度選択UI（1-5段階）

4. **Plan Mode統合**
   - 既存実装を確認・統合
   - 承認ゲート、実行モード、予算管理

5. **package.json更新**
   - 14個の新コマンド追加
   - 2つの新ビュー追加
   - 6つの新設定追加

6. **extension.ts統合**
   - CoworkManagerとSandboxManagerを初期化
   - 既存のOrchestratorClientと連携

### 使用方法

**VSIXパッケージング**:
```powershell
cd extensions/vscode-codex
.\package-vsix.ps1 -Version 2.12.0 -Install
```

**Cursorでの使用**:
1. VSIXファイルをインストール
2. Command Paletteから各機能にアクセス
   - `Codex: Cowork: Navigate Browser`
   - `Codex: Sandbox: Configure`
   - `Codex: Deep Research`
   - `Codex: Create Blueprint`

### 関連ファイル

- `extensions/vscode-codex/src/cowork/manager.ts` - Cowork統合
- `extensions/vscode-codex/src/sandbox/manager.ts` - Sandbox管理
- `extensions/vscode-codex/src/extension.ts` - 統合エントリーポイント
- `extensions/vscode-codex/package.json` - コマンド・設定定義
- `_docs/2026-01-29_VSIX拡張機能統合{Cursor}.md` - 実装ログ

CursorでCodexのCowork、Deep Research、Plan Mode、macOS風サンドボックスが使えるようになりました。

# Codex VSIX Packaging Script
# Cursor統合用VSIXファイルを自動生成するで〜

param(
    [string]$Version = "",
    [switch]$Clean = $false,
    [switch]$Install = $false
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
Set-StrictMode -Version Latest

# カラー出力用
function Write-ColorOutput($ForegroundColor, $Message) {
    $fc = $host.UI.RawUI.ForegroundColor
    $host.UI.RawUI.ForegroundColor = $ForegroundColor
    Write-Output $Message
    $host.UI.RawUI.ForegroundColor = $fc
}

function Write-Progress-Bar {
    param(
        [int]$Percent,
        [string]$Activity,
        [string]$Status
    )
    Write-Progress -Activity $Activity -Status $Status -PercentComplete $Percent
}

# プロジェクトルート取得
$scriptRoot = Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path
$extensionRoot = $scriptRoot
$projectRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $scriptRoot)

Write-ColorOutput Green "🚀 Codex VSIX パッケージング開始やで〜"
Write-ColorOutput Cyan "📁 Extension Root: $extensionRoot"
Write-ColorOutput Cyan "📁 Project Root: $projectRoot"

# バージョン取得
if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($Version)) {
    $packageJson = Get-Content "$extensionRoot/package.json" | ConvertFrom-Json
    $Version = $packageJson.version
}
Write-ColorOutput Yellow "📦 Version: $Version"

# クリーンビルド
if ($Clean) {
    Write-ColorOutput Yellow "🧹 クリーンビルド実行中..."
    Write-Progress-Bar -Percent 10 -Activity "Cleaning" -Status "Removing old files"
    
    Remove-Item -Path "$extensionRoot/out" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Remove-Item -Path "$extensionRoot/*.vsix" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Remove-Item -Path "$extensionRoot/node_modules/.cache" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    
    Write-ColorOutput Green "✅ クリーン完了"
}

# 依存関係インストール
Write-ColorOutput Yellow "📥 依存関係インストール中..."
Write-Progress-Bar -Percent 20 -Activity "Installing" -Status "Installing npm dependencies"

Push-Location $extensionRoot
try {
    if (-not (Test-Path "node_modules")) {
        npm install
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            throw "npm install failed"
        }
    }
    Write-ColorOutput Green "✅ 依存関係インストール完了"
} finally {
    Pop-Location
}

# TypeScriptコンパイル
Write-ColorOutput Yellow "🔨 TypeScriptコンパイル中..."
Write-Progress-Bar -Percent 40 -Activity "Compiling" -Status "Compiling TypeScript"

Push-Location $extensionRoot
try {
    npm run compile
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "TypeScript compilation failed"
    }
    Write-ColorOutput Green "✅ コンパイル完了"
} finally {
    Pop-Location
}

# vsceパッケージング
Write-ColorOutput Yellow "📦 VSIXパッケージング中..."
Write-Progress-Bar -Percent 70 -Activity "Packaging" -Status "Creating VSIX file"

$vsixPath = $null
Push-Location $extensionRoot
try {
    # vsceがインストールされているか確認
    $vsceInstalled = npm list -g @vscode/vsce 2>$null
    if (-not $vsceInstalled) {
        Write-ColorOutput Yellow "📦 vsceをグローバルインストール中..."
        npm install -g @vscode/vsce
    }
    
    # VSIXパッケージ作成
    $vsixFileName = "codex-assistant-$Version.vsix"
    vsce package --out $vsixFileName
    
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "VSIX packaging failed"
    }
    
    $vsixPath = Join-Path $extensionRoot $vsixFileName
    if (Test-Path $vsixPath) {
        $fileSize = (Get-Item $vsixPath).Length / 1MB
        Write-ColorOutput Green "✅ VSIXパッケージ作成完了: $vsixFileName ($([math]::Round($fileSize, 2)) MB)"
    } else {
        throw "VSIX file not found after packaging"
    }
} finally {
    Pop-Location
}

# Cursor統合用MCP設定ファイル生成
Write-ColorOutput Yellow "🔗 Cursor統合用MCP設定ファイル生成中..."
Write-Progress-Bar -Percent 85 -Activity "Configuring" -Status "Generating MCP config"

$mcpConfigPath = Join-Path $projectRoot ".cursor/mcp.json"
$mcpConfigDir = Split-Path -Parent $mcpConfigPath

if (-not (Test-Path $mcpConfigDir)) {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $mcpConfigDir -Force | Out-Null
}

$mcpConfig = @{
    mcpServers = @{
        codex = @{
            command = "codex"
            args = @("mcp-server")
            env = @{}
            description = "Codex Multi-Agent System with Deep Research, Sub-Agents, and Blueprint Mode"
            disabled = $false
        }
    }
} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10

Set-Content -Path $mcpConfigPath -Value $mcpConfig -Encoding UTF8
Write-ColorOutput Green "✅ MCP設定ファイル生成完了: $mcpConfigPath"

# インストール（オプション）
if ($Install) {
    if ($null -eq $vsixPath) {
        Write-ColorOutput Red "❌ VSIXファイルが見つかりません。パッケージングを先に実行してください。"
    } else {
        Write-ColorOutput Yellow "📥 VSIXインストール中..."
        Write-Progress-Bar -Percent 95 -Activity "Installing" -Status "Installing VSIX to Cursor"
        
        $cursorPath = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\cursor\Cursor.exe"
        if (Test-Path $cursorPath) {
            & $cursorPath --install-extension $vsixPath
            Write-ColorOutput Green "✅ VSIXインストール完了（Cursor再起動が必要やで）"
        } else {
            Write-ColorOutput Yellow "⚠️  Cursorが見つからんかった。手動でインストールしてくれ:"
            Write-ColorOutput Cyan "   code --install-extension $vsixPath"
        }
    }
}

Write-Progress-Bar -Percent 100 -Activity "Complete" -Status "Done"
Write-ColorOutput Green "🎉 パッケージング完了やで〜！"
Write-ColorOutput Cyan "📦 VSIXファイル: $vsixPath"

```bash
cd c:\Users\downl\Desktop\codex-main\extensions\vscode-codex; $content = @'
# Codex VSIX Packaging Script
# Cursor統合用VSIXファイルを自動生成するで〜

param(
    [string]$Version = "",
    [switch]$Clean = $false,
    [switch]$Install = $false
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
Set-StrictMode -Version Latest

# カラー出力用
function Write-ColorOutput($ForegroundColor, $Message) {
    $fc = $host.UI.RawUI.ForegroundColor
    $host.UI.RawUI.ForegroundColor = $ForegroundColor
    Write-Output $Message
    $host.UI.RawUI.ForegroundColor = $fc
}

function Write-Progress-Bar {
    param(
        [int]$Percent,
        [string]$Activity,
        [string]$Status
    )
    Write-Progress -Activity $Activity -Status $Status -PercentComplete $Percent
}

# プロジェクトルート取得
$scriptRoot = Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path
$extensionRoot = $scriptRoot
$projectRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $scriptRoot)

Write-ColorOutput Green "🚀 Codex VSIX パッケージング開始やで〜"
Write-ColorOutput Cyan "📁 Extension Root: $extensionRoot"
Write-ColorOutput Cyan "📁 Project Root: $projectRoot"

# バージョン取得
if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($Version)) {
    $packageJson = Get-Content "$extensionRoot/package.json" | ConvertFrom-Json
    $Version = $packageJson.version
}
Write-ColorOutput Yellow "📦 Version: $Version"

# クリーンビルド
if ($Clean) {
    Write-ColorOutput Yellow "🧹 クリーンビルド実行中..."
    Write-Progress-Bar -Percent 10 -Activity "Cleaning" -Status "Removing old files"
    
    Remove-Item -Path "$extensionRoot/out" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Remove-Item -Path "$extensionRoot/*.vsix" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Remove-Item -Path "$extensionRoot/node_modules/.cache" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    
    Write-ColorOutput Green "✅ クリーン完了"
}

# 依存関係インストール
Write-ColorOutput Yellow "📥 依存関係インストール中..."
Write-Progress-Bar -Percent 20 -Activity "Installing" -Status "Installing npm dependencies"

Push-Location $extensionRoot
try {
    if (-not (Test-Path "node_modules")) {
        npm install
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            throw "npm install failed"
        }
    }
    Write-ColorOutput Green "✅ 依存関係インストール完了"
} finally {
    Pop-Location
}

# TypeScriptコンパイル
Write-ColorOutput Yellow "🔨 TypeScriptコンパイル中..."
Write-Progress-Bar -Percent 40 -Activity "Compiling" -Status "Compiling TypeScript"

Push-Location $extensionRoot
try {
    npm run compile
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "TypeScript compilation failed"
    }
    Write-ColorOutput Green "✅ コンパイル完了"
} finally {
    Pop-Location
}

# vsceパッケージング
Write-ColorOutput Yellow "📦 VSIXパッケージング中..."
Write-Progress-Bar -Percent 70 -Activity "Packaging" -Status "Creating VSIX file"

$vsixPath = $null
Push-Location $extensionRoot
try {
    # vsceがインストールされているか確認
    $vsceInstalled = npm list -g @vscode/vsce 2>$null
    if (-not $vsceInstalled) {
        Write-ColorOutput Yellow "📦 vsceをグローバルインストール中..."
        npm install -g @vscode/vsce
    }
    
    # VSIXパッケージ作成
    $vsixFileName = "codex-assistant-$Version.vsix"
    vsce package --out $vsixFileName
    
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "VSIX packaging failed"
    }
    
    $vsixPath = Join-Path $extensionRoot $vsixFileName
    if (Test-Path $vsixPath) {
        $fileSize = (Get-Item $vsixPath).Length / 1MB
        Write-ColorOutput Green "✅ VSIXパッケージ作成完了: $vsixFileName ($([math]::Round($fileSize, 2)) MB)"
    } else {
        throw "VSIX file not found after packaging"
    }
} finally {
    Pop-Location
}

# Cursor統合用MCP設定ファイル生成
Write-ColorOutput Yellow "🔗 Cursor統合用MCP設定ファイル生成中..."
Write-Progress-Bar -Percent 85 -Activity "Configuring" -Status "Generating MCP config"

$mcpConfigPath = Join-Path $projectRoot ".cursor/mcp.json"
$mcpConfigDir = Split-Path -Parent $mcpConfigPath

if (-not (Test-Path $mcpConfigDir)) {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $mcpConfigDir -Force | Out-Null
}

$mcpConfig = @{
    mcpServers = @{
        codex = @{
            command = "codex"
            args = @("mcp-server")
            env = @{}
            description = "Codex Multi-Agent System with Deep Research, Sub-Agents, and Blueprint Mode"
            disabled = $false
        }
    }
} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10

Set-Content -Path $mcpConfigPath -Value $mcpConfig -Encoding UTF8
Write-ColorOutput Green "✅ MCP設定ファイル生成完了: $mcpConfigPath"

# インストール（オプション）
if ($Install) {
    if ($null -eq $vsixPath) {
        Write-ColorOutput Red "❌ VSIXファイルが見つかりません。パッケージングを先に実行してください。"
    } else {
        Write-ColorOutput Yellow "📥 VSIXインストール中..."
        Write-Progress-Bar -Percent 95 -Activity "Installing" -Status "Installing VSIX to Cursor"
        
        $cursorPath = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\cursor\Cursor.exe"
        if (Test-Path $cursorPath) {
            & $cursorPath --install-extension $vsixPath
            Write-ColorOutput Green "✅ VSIXインストール完了（Cursor再起動が必要やで）"
        } else {
            Write-ColorOutput Yellow "⚠️  Cursorが見つからんかった。手動でインストールしてくれ:"
            Write-ColorOutput Cyan "   code --install-extension $vsixPath"
        }
    }
}

Write-Progress-Bar -Percent 100 -Activity "Complete" -Status "Done"
Write-ColorOutput Green "🎉 パッケージング完了やで〜！"
Write-ColorOutput Cyan "📦 VSIXファイル: $vsixPath"
Write-ColorOutput Cyan "🔗 MCP設定: $mcpConfigPath"
'@; [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText("package-vsix.ps1", $content, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)); Write-Host "✅ ファイル再作成完了"
```

<tool-use data-tool-type="shell" data-tool-name="run_terminal_command_v2">
<details><summary>Tool use: **run_terminal_command_v2** • Run command: cd c:\Users\downl\Desktop\codex-main\extensions\vscode-codex; $content = @'
# Codex VSIX Packaging Script
# Cursor統合用VSIXファイルを自動生成

param(
    [string]$Version = "",
    [switch]$Clean = $false,
    [switch]$Install = $false
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
Set-StrictMode -Version Latest

function Write-ColorOutput($ForegroundColor, $Message) {
    $fc = $host.UI.RawUI.ForegroundColor
    $host.UI.RawUI.ForegroundColor = $ForegroundColor
    Write-Output $Message
    $host.UI.RawUI.ForegroundColor = $fc
}

function Write-Progress-Bar {
    param([int]$Percent, [string]$Activity, [string]$Status)
    Write-Progress -Activity $Activity -Status $Status -PercentComplete $Percent
}

$scriptRoot = Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path
$extensionRoot = $scriptRoot
$projectRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $scriptRoot)

Write-ColorOutput Green "[START] Codex VSIX packaging started"
Write-ColorOutput Cyan "[INFO] Extension Root: $extensionRoot"
Write-ColorOutput Cyan "[INFO] Project Root: $projectRoot"

if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($Version)) {
    $packageJson = Get-Content "$extensionRoot/package.json" | ConvertFrom-Json
    $Version = $packageJson.version
}
Write-ColorOutput Yellow "[VERSION] Version: $Version"

if ($Clean) {
    Write-ColorOutput Yellow "[CLEAN] Cleaning build artifacts..."
    Write-Progress-Bar -Percent 10 -Activity "Cleaning" -Status "Removing old files"
    Remove-Item -Path "$extensionRoot/out" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Remove-Item -Path "$extensionRoot/*.vsix" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Remove-Item -Path "$extensionRoot/node_modules/.cache" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Write-ColorOutput Green "[OK] Clean completed"
}

Write-ColorOutput Yellow "[INSTALL] Installing dependencies..."
Write-Progress-Bar -Percent 20 -Activity "Installing" -Status "Installing npm dependencies"
Push-Location $extensionRoot
try {
    if (-not (Test-Path "node_modules")) {
        npm install
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "npm install failed" }
    }
    Write-ColorOutput Green "[OK] Dependencies installed"
} finally { Pop-Location }

Write-ColorOutput Yellow "[COMPILE] Compiling TypeScript..."
Write-Progress-Bar -Percent 40 -Activity "Compiling" -Status "Compiling TypeScript"
Push-Location $extensionRoot
try {
    npm run compile
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "TypeScript compilation failed" }
    Write-ColorOutput Green "[OK] Compilation completed"
} finally { Pop-Location }

Write-ColorOutput Yellow "[PACKAGE] Packaging VSIX..."
Write-Progress-Bar -Percent 70 -Activity "Packaging" -Status "Creating VSIX file"
$vsixPath = $null
Push-Location $extensionRoot
try {
    $vsceInstalled = npm list -g @vscode/vsce 2>$null
    if (-not $vsceInstalled) {
        Write-ColorOutput Yellow "[INSTALL] Installing vsce globally..."
        npm install -g @vscode/vsce
    }
    $vsixFileName = "codex-assistant-$Version.vsix"
    vsce package --out $vsixFileName
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "VSIX packaging failed" }
    $vsixPath = Join-Path $extensionRoot $vsixFileName
    if (Test-Path $vsixPath) {
        $fileSize = (Get-Item $vsixPath).Length / 1MB
        Write-ColorOutput Green "[OK] VSIX package created: $vsixFileName ($([math]::Round($fileSize, 2)) MB)"
    } else { throw "VSIX file not found after packaging" }
} finally { Pop-Location }

Write-ColorOutput Yellow "[CONFIG] Generating MCP config..."
Write-Progress-Bar -Percent 85 -Activity "Configuring" -Status "Generating MCP config"
$mcpConfigPath = Join-Path $projectRoot ".cursor/mcp.json"
$mcpConfigDir = Split-Path -Parent $mcpConfigPath
if (-not (Test-Path $mcpConfigDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $mcpConfigDir -Force | Out-Null }
$mcpConfig = @{ mcpServers = @{ codex = @{ command = "codex"; args = @("mcp-server"); env = @{}; description = "Codex Multi-Agent System"; disabled = $false } } } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10
Set-Content -Path $mcpConfigPath -Value $mcpConfig -Encoding UTF8
Write-ColorOutput Green "[OK] MCP config generated: $mcpConfigPath"

if ($Install) {
    if ($null -eq $vsixPath) {
        Write-ColorOutput Red "[ERROR] VSIX file not found. Run packaging first."
    } else {
        Write-ColorOutput Yellow "[INSTALL] Installing VSIX..."
        Write-Progress-Bar -Percent 95 -Activity "Installing" -Status "Installing VSIX to Cursor"
        $cursorPath = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\cursor\Cursor.exe"
        if (Test-Path $cursorPath) {
            & $cursorPath --install-extension $vsixPath
            Write-ColorOutput Green "[OK] VSIX installed (Cursor restart required)"
        } else {
            Write-ColorOutput Yellow "[WARN] Cursor not found. Install manually:"
            Write-ColorOutput Cyan "[INFO] code --install-extension $vsixPath"
        }
    }
}

Write-Progress-Bar -Percent 100 -Activity "Complete" -Status "Done"
Write-ColorOutput Green "[DONE] Packaging completed!"
Write-ColorOutput Cyan "[INFO] VSIX file: $vsixPath"
Write-ColorOutput Cyan "[INFO] MCP config: $mcpConfigPath"
'@; $utf8 = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $true; [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText("package-vsix.ps1", $content, $utf8); Write-Host "File recreated successfully"</summary>
